To give you the answer right away,
they’re all divisible by 3.

4286cba35766e11e1eeffbc1e1349eb54b1bbb5a.source:
並んだ3つ分の数字であるならば
順番を入れ替えても大丈夫なのよ。
4286cba35766e11e1eeffbc1e1349eb54b1bbb5a.english:
If you have three numbers in a row,
it doesn't matter what order you put them in.

76d5f5fdb8cf036eb3d27f2e26efab299b37b445.source:
こういう法則がわかると
面白いの。素数なんかもね。
76d5f5fdb8cf036eb3d27f2e26efab299b37b445.english:
It’s quite interesting once you understand
these kinds of rules, like those involving prime numbers, for instance.

84c63a580c52077023504e8b29c34d4966ee59ea.source: もう一度、問題を確認するカイ？
84c63a580c52077023504e8b29c34d4966ee59ea.english: Would you like to review the question again?

89485930ecebcedeee55d9442e9c62e579d660fe.source:
「71」「72」「73」のように、
連続する3つの数は、
89485930ecebcedeee55d9442e9c62e579d660fe.english:
Take three consecutive numbers,
like 71, 72, and 73, for example,

eaf785b393705032e76bca7d36963ffc7fcffb21.source:
並んだ数字の順番を入れ替えた
以下の数にした場合、
eaf785b393705032e76bca7d36963ffc7fcffb21.english:
and rearrange their digits to form
a new number...

6717df847a18cf9512af8c956a16b9a93843e653.source: 3で割り切ることができるでショーカ？
6717df847a18cf9512af8c956a16b9a93843e653.english: ...will that new number always be divisible by 3?

29cef6ae0336c25d44d28eeef411e3a9a7fb051a.source:
正解！　だけど不正解！
ザンネンデシター！
29cef6ae0336c25d44d28eeef411e3a9a7fb051a.english:
Correct! But also incorrect!
Too bad for you!

74dad7a84c5f8a1dd02cf616d82c5abb15d5b22b.source:
ぴんぽんぴんぽーん！
大正解デス！

d0dfdf154dc06c5c87f177051c8b0d874bf47275.source:
仕方がないので
どいてやりマスー！
d0dfdf154dc06c5c87f177051c8b0d874bf47275.english:
Well, I suppose I have no choice,
I’ll move out of the way!

f886640e473d18752ae8746949286196b72248b0.english: Black screen + sound of flowing water<keywait>

e455f19081ba0819bccecc4801269003ec55720f.source: 遠くで水の流れる音がした……。<keywait>
e455f19081ba0819bccecc4801269003ec55720f.english: The sound of flowing water could be heard in the distance...<keywait>

4be9427c82f4c493d8ba1fd361f40519857e8471.source:
ムリヤリどかせるのですカ？
“暴力”を使っテ！
4be9427c82f4c493d8ba1fd361f40519857e8471.english:
Are you going to force me to move?
By using... “violence”?!

b2f9d64be7da2a8e93078b3e3be63de9642f93ef.source: 奴のルールに従うしかないな。
b2f9d64be7da2a8e93078b3e3be63de9642f93ef.english: Looks like we have no choice but to follow his rules.

f0cbeb89b70f7906eb3615edb71390d4c92fd12c.source:
仕方ないわね……。
あんたをどかせるにはどうすればいい？
f0cbeb89b70f7906eb3615edb71390d4c92fd12c.english:
Fine, then...
What do we have to do to get you to move?

62c06d297070c4ed78151af6047045d8c5a9c289.source:
ワタクシの出す問題に
見事正解するだけデス！
62c06d297070c4ed78151af6047045d8c5a9c289.english:
All you have to do is
get the answer to my riddle right!

165a18c4308688ea8bb0fcd6b176f26805460496.source:
ってことらしいわ。
問題を解いてこいつをどかせましょう。
165a18c4308688ea8bb0fcd6b176f26805460496.english:
So that’s how it is, then.
Let’s solve the riddle and get this guy out of the way.

7fc088dde46e6b1145f05987748c9dae0b5ee7be.english:
Now, here’s a riddle!
“Who ended up losing money?”

4782fd75e62e1e50e9ba221755cafbfb3cf6aaeb.source:
ある酒場に旅人がやってきた。
旅人は1万ギルをカウンターに置き、
4782fd75e62e1e50e9ba221755cafbfb3cf6aaeb.english:
A traveler arrived at a tavern.
He placed 10,000 gil on the counter,

796904e7eb1b57875e2599639a2149f4f3be4da0.source:
「好きな酒があったら支払う」
と言って階段を下りていった。
796904e7eb1b57875e2599639a2149f4f3be4da0.english:
“If you have a drink I like, I’ll pay for it,”
he said, before heading down the stairs.

672689946c4f43955e7e4acc093e22eddf9d9a20.source:
酒場の主人はその金を掴んで店を出た。
そして土地貸しにツケてもらっている
今月分の土地代の残りを払った。
672689946c4f43955e7e4acc093e22eddf9d9a20.english:
The tavern keeper took the money and left the establishment.
He used it to pay off the remainder of his rent
for the current month to his landlord.

4d2cbea552f1fb2e477bfe6d001e7c8cb1ab3752.source:
土地貸しはその金を掴んで店を出た。
賭場の男にツケてもらっている
負け分を支払った。
4d2cbea552f1fb2e477bfe6d001e7c8cb1ab3752.english:
The landlord took the money and left.
He used it to settle a gambling debt
he owed to a man at a gambling den.

1b64ebcb5ed58a600e9400c199eaff5d129e5909.source:
賭場の男はその金を掴んで店を出た。
愛人の女に妻への口止め料を払った。
1b64ebcb5ed58a600e9400c199eaff5d129e5909.english:
The man from the gambling den took the money and left.
He paid it to his mistress as hush money to keep her from telling his wife.

83fe7decde5c798d0424af6f95e91611170dc9e7.source:
女はその金を掴んで家を出た。
酒場の主人にツケてもらっている
酒代として酒場のカウンターに置いた。
83fe7decde5c798d0424af6f95e91611170dc9e7.english:
The woman took the money and left her home.
She placed it on the tavern counter to pay off
the tab she had run up with the tavern keeper.

6a0bbeb3acc55c1d1e383bc434ae9cd0151d159c.source:
階段を上ってくる音がして
旅人が戻ってきた。
6a0bbeb3acc55c1d1e383bc434ae9cd0151d159c.english:
Then, the sound of footsteps coming up the stairs,
the traveler had returned.

a64b39b73207063b93071e3af775ebf0d8abe8a2.source:
旅人は、好みの酒がなかったと、
カウンターに置いてある1万ギルを
回収して店を出て行った。
a64b39b73207063b93071e3af775ebf0d8abe8a2.english:
Finding that the establishment didn't stock the drink he
wanted, the traveler took back the 10,000 gil he
had left on the counter and walked out.

58c257d8e4f0d480be68fbe15246a0741daccee2.source:
この1万ギルを
誰も使用していないにもかかわらず
関与した多くの人が笑顔になった。
58c257d8e4f0d480be68fbe15246a0741daccee2.english:
Even though that
10,000 gil was never actually spent, everyone
involved ended up with a smile on their face.

6f3a6050061e38a54cc8762b171ee087a2f63460.source: さて、損をしたのは誰でしょう？

1fe537e181070b65ba78eb24b7943f16c8c3a42d.english: This is a matter of claims, of debts and credits.

bad312ff5c126b34cf870591492a8b0fe2059ee5.source:
一見、全員が債権を無にした
ようにも思えるが、実は違う。
bad312ff5c126b34cf870591492a8b0fe2059ee5.english:
It might look as though everyone simply
wiped away their claims, but that’s not quite the case.

2ad05745575e43e0e0adf715db785d2ddec0252f.source:
金を受け取った“確認”をしていない
ヤツがひとりいるだろう？
2ad05745575e43e0e0adf715db785d2ddec0252f.english:
There’s one person who never actually
*confirmed* receiving the money, isn't there?

b5c3f06614db11aa2cecc8d732f45ee8be4a38c9.source:
実物のないものを貸したり、
借りたりする……。
b5c3f06614db11aa2cecc8d732f45ee8be4a38c9.english:
When you lend or borrow things
that don't physically exist...

bcc4f866b2916ac4cee768f2105c3d956ad8e3f4.source:
そういうときのために、契約書や
借用書なんていう紙きれが必要なのさ。
bcc4f866b2916ac4cee768f2105c3d956ad8e3f4.english:
...that’s exactly why you need scraps
of paper like contracts or promissory notes.

e5fbd22f5ec27faa0d359a999cc4fdf4ae4c0f93.source:
この手の問題はマダムのほうが得意ね。
実際、こういうことがあるみたいだし。
e5fbd22f5ec27faa0d359a999cc4fdf4ae4c0f93.english:
Madam is better at handling these kinds of issues.
It seems things like this do happen, after all.

ad5d344a00ac5e51fb5aa477e5d215dbc088c228.source:
実物のないものをやり取りするなんて
あたしはちょっと気が引けちゃうな。
ad5d344a00ac5e51fb5aa477e5d215dbc088c228.english:
Trading things that don't actually exist...
I’m not really comfortable with that.

b306067428dcef14654cc0265caef66cb823468a.source:
貸すのはいいけど、
借りって響きがイヤなのよね～……。
b306067428dcef14654cc0265caef66cb823468a.english:
I don't mind lending things out, but
I just don't like the sound of 'borrowing'…

e209937df8e42490586b136bd1e75b9959c8534c.source:
そんなわけないでショ！
出直してきなサイ！

2254fbac28903cdd36a782dd09a2cc89b03502e7.source:
そういやここでの
ペナルティは考えてなかったヨ！
2254fbac28903cdd36a782dd09a2cc89b03502e7.english:
Oh, wait, I hadn't even considered the
penalties here!

3df57f85733b7097241cb9927caf6fd1759f8de2.source:
キミ、テキトーに言ってナイ？
わかるんだヨ、そういうノ！
3df57f85733b7097241cb9927caf6fd1759f8de2.english:
Hey, are you just making this up as you go?
I can tell when someone’s doing that!

27d652b564faced40060765d858ad3b695ccb5fc.source:
考えることを放棄するなんテ
キミの頭の中、カラッポなのネ！
27d652b564faced40060765d858ad3b695ccb5fc.english:
Giving up on thinking altogether…
Is your head completely empty in there?!

d5cc676d526c6a69f45fbba5efbe10576f5d4163.source:
これがほんとのトリアタマ！
キョエ～～～！

e80f4e1b64c28137a3224a5a074f278f9d46bb18.source:
さて、この1万ギルを
誰も使用していないにもかかわらず
関与した多くの人が笑顔になった。
e80f4e1b64c28137a3224a5a074f278f9d46bb18.english:
So, even though this 10,000 gil
was never actually spent,
everyone involved ended up smiling.

30fe24cb92dc51372b718b20a6bb62829ba7e8b6.source:
女はツケを払ったつもりになってるケド
主人はその金を持っていかれてるヨ！
30fe24cb92dc51372b718b20a6bb62829ba7e8b6.english:
The woman thinks she’s paid off her tab,
but the tavern keeper is the one who’s actually out that money!

6afbc556671fc649fd32886ece6a6bd860c14222.source:
まあ、元々、
酒場の主人が旅人の許可を得ずに、
6afbc556671fc649fd32886ece6a6bd860c14222.english:
Well, then again,
if you consider that the tavern keeper

39477fceb6413cf1944bf942dd076a1426ce6677.source:
オイタして盗った金と
するならば、自業自得だけどネ！
39477fceb6413cf1944bf942dd076a1426ce6677.english:
stole that money from the traveler in the first place,
I suppose he only has himself to blame!

debcde2e41bce6b18439187d3a4a63ba94b2a83a.source:
というわけで！
仕方がないのでどいてやりマスー！
debcde2e41bce6b18439187d3a4a63ba94b2a83a.english:
Well then!
I suppose I have no choice, I’ll move aside!

0247626aa569b9148c03e183bbd2443c83a750ae.source: 「真実の左目」を台座に置きますか？
0247626aa569b9148c03e183bbd2443c83a750ae.english: Place the 'Left Eye of Truth' on the pedestal?

793e83a742765039e5a5e87dc548368aa21b7bfb.source: 「真実の左目」を台座に置いた。<keywait>
793e83a742765039e5a5e87dc548368aa21b7bfb.english: Placed the 'Left Eye of Truth' on the pedestal.<keywait>

36b075b72fdf7d8eccb9744b2b18373aa6d383a1.source: 「真実の右目」を台座に置きますか？
36b075b72fdf7d8eccb9744b2b18373aa6d383a1.english: Place the 'Right Eye of Truth' on the pedestal?

0c17bf7f8871eb1d4537336b1cfedbb21acf8ff2.source: 「真実の右目」を台座に置いた。<keywait>
0c17bf7f8871eb1d4537336b1cfedbb21acf8ff2.english: Placed the 'Right Eye of Truth' on the pedestal.<keywait>

19e36dba752b351828fbcd69d40dc855105e5c12.source:
壮観だな。
燐光花につられて、多くの燐光蝶が
この部屋にやって来たらしい。
19e36dba752b351828fbcd69d40dc855105e5c12.english:
A spectacular sight.
It seems the phosphorescent flowers have drawn a great many phosphorescent butterflies
into this room.

c9b7d54ed28251ff46e1cd366f54fde9e2537053.source:
持ち込まれた力という判断も
されていない。暗闇を歩くための
答えとして、正解だったようだ。
c9b7d54ed28251ff46e1cd366f54fde9e2537053.english:
It doesn't appear to have been flagged as an 'introduced power,' either.It seems this was the right answer
for navigating the darkness.

e036d3a7cf1fd8c7e8f5f9a246b9fb5470b5bab1.source:
おかげで、奥のほうまで
進んで行けるわね。
調べてみましょう。
e036d3a7cf1fd8c7e8f5f9a246b9fb5470b5bab1.english:
Thanks to this, we can make our way
further inside.
Let’s go take a look.

ac21ab438d02f38584280dc638edb4efb6bfe986.source:
どれ、石碑を調べてみようか。
ボウヤはそっちを頼む。
ac21ab438d02f38584280dc638edb4efb6bfe986.english:
Well then, let’s take a look at these tablets.
You take that one, kid.

9a24fe1f325e017d89f4ebe979eb6387153401c5.source:
ムクロのシレン……？
どういうこと？
9a24fe1f325e017d89f4ebe979eb6387153401c5.english:
The 'Trial of the Corpse'...?
What could that mean?

87171186b4de836c8c09b674b153adc7df340de5.source:
ここまで進んできた中で、
骸なんてものはなかったはず──
87171186b4de836c8c09b674b153adc7df340de5.english:
We haven’t come across any corpses
on our way here, have we?

9c2f747439251dabfc04beb7c1302f81452ae202.source:
発見と驚き。
これぞまさに冒険の醍醐味だな……。
9c2f747439251dabfc04beb7c1302f81452ae202.english:
Discovery and surprise...
Now *this* is what adventure is all about!

4c585c9f221f3e1dd8586fa168184cf335c93239.source:
お前たちも自分の目で
確かめてみるといい。
4c585c9f221f3e1dd8586fa168184cf335c93239.english:
You should all take a look
for yourselves.

40dd8b2e1ca7e5ddba5c3c81211548191645e249.source:
石碑だけじゃなく、
きっとその宝箱の中にも
面白いものが入っているぞ。
40dd8b2e1ca7e5ddba5c3c81211548191645e249.english:
It’s not just the stone tablets,
I’m sure there’s something interesting
inside that treasure chest, too.

56be21dff5483f04a5d373b5db6683afc4b20d6e.source: 遠くで鉄格子の開く物音がした。<keywait>
56be21dff5483f04a5d373b5db6683afc4b20d6e.english: In the distance, the sound of iron bars opening could be heard.<keywait>

828319f5836843071cc3273c90a59677b2226d0e.source:
透明な壁が邪魔をして
先へ進むことができない。
828319f5836843071cc3273c90a59677b2226d0e.english:
An invisible wall is blocking the way,
preventing any further progress.

e721722c4d47dd93e5d47e542cc5c46cfa473a0f.source:
無視して進もうとしても無駄ダヨ！
ルールに従わない“力”は
暴力って判定されて戻されちゃうのサ！
e721722c4d47dd93e5d47e542cc5c46cfa473a0f.english:
It’s no use trying to ignore the rules and push forward!
Any “power” that doesn’t follow the rules
gets classified as violence, and you’ll just be sent back!

f7ae4a08a5cac42fb7cca4c058aa749c9a261140.source:
『罠の階』は
これで終わりのようだな。
f7ae4a08a5cac42fb7cca4c058aa749c9a261140.english:
Looks like
that’s the end of the ‘Trap Floor.’

80556e78d6fe004a872bb5ce4e52712644a5015f.source:
大変ではあったけど
けっこう楽しかったかも。
80556e78d6fe004a872bb5ce4e52712644a5015f.english:
It was quite a challenge, but
I actually kind of enjoyed it.

8ed25604ead2a6c0dd6daed66cc9e22d88600827.source:
感想を言うのはまだ早いぞ。
前の階層と同じ構造ならば
次は守護モンスターがいるはずだ。
8ed25604ead2a6c0dd6daed66cc9e22d88600827.english:
Don’t start sharing your impressions just yet.
If the layout follows the same pattern as the previous floor,
there should be a guardian monster waiting for us next.

1b80b18423af2be2e77afa7ee9bbbac35c8a78a3.source:
頭を使った後だから
体を動かすのは望むところよ。
1b80b18423af2be2e77afa7ee9bbbac35c8a78a3.english:
After all that mental exercise,
I’m actually looking forward to getting some physical action.

17a190b8b6661725a5c71bff15df3c809eef03df.source: お前は昔から逆境に強いな。
17a190b8b6661725a5c71bff15df3c809eef03df.english: You’ve always been good at handling adversity, haven’t you?

7a4cabf297360af8236a271611bc75da8eef1710.source:
誰かさんの背中を見て
育ってるからじゃない？
7a4cabf297360af8236a271611bc75da8eef1710.english:
Maybe that’s because I grew up
watching someone else’s back?

43115728443f9646d1bc22c234cb41d0ee5105e6.source:
ボウヤもまだまだ
疲れてなんていないよな？
43115728443f9646d1bc22c234cb41d0ee5105e6.english:
And you’re not tired yet, are you,
kiddo?

cdc903009ffd3250f2c4b8789a054232927bf850.source:
私のボディガードとして
行き止まりまで
付き合わせるから覚悟しな。
cdc903009ffd3250f2c4b8789a054232927bf850.english:
You’re going to be my bodyguards,
and you’ll be sticking with
me all the way to the end of the line, so brace yourselves.

7674db4af1203d5df62d5eca06f3cf87f28b42e9.source: こいつが次の守護モンスターか。
7674db4af1203d5df62d5eca06f3cf87f28b42e9.english: So, this is the next guardian monster, then?

e59c87556944ca5621be7ebb20acd151733d55b2.source:
お前たちは離れていろ。
巻き添えを食うぞ。
e59c87556944ca5621be7ebb20acd151733d55b2.english:
Stay back, all of you.
You don’t want to get caught in the crossfire.

c1c9679241ba5a5bd2d4bb7160c5b5e17df21ffb.source: あたしたちも一緒に戦うわ。

c6773b78197da24fff2d79b40c78356fa4d49b81.source:
いいだろう。
だが面倒は見ないぞ。
ちゃんと私についてこい。
c6773b78197da24fff2d79b40c78356fa4d49b81.english:
Fine, then.
But don’t expect me to look after you.
Just make sure you keep up with me.

9f3d767d1c85ea9337a4d4dfb82a2e5134c04796.source: オオ……その輝きは我らが主様の……。
9f3d767d1c85ea9337a4d4dfb82a2e5134c04796.english: Oh… That radiance… it belongs to our master…

9281583ed4f1229c5ac9b4d262716ad65acd51ea.source:
お帰りなさいませ。
この先へ行くのでしたら
どうぞお進みください。
9281583ed4f1229c5ac9b4d262716ad65acd51ea.english:
Welcome back.
If you intend to head further ahead,
please, by all means, proceed.

fe3ab0c708de8b3a2861f8e7a3ac2b41c98a9140.source:
わたしはいずれ訪れる
侵入者どもを排除する力を、
ここで蓄え続けましょう。
fe3ab0c708de8b3a2861f8e7a3ac2b41c98a9140.english:
I shall continue to amass the power
needed to eliminate any intruders
who may arrive here.

6de3dae5442088a31fbbe82938e1e0c86e9c1a82.source:
マダム。
もしかして、イグルが
言ってた「通行許可」って……。
6de3dae5442088a31fbbe82938e1e0c86e9c1a82.english:
Madam...
Could it be that the 'passage permit'
Igul mentioned was...

14e772f60d203b25b59bc98ee4617a56106303fe.source: 私にかけた光のことだろうな。
14e772f60d203b25b59bc98ee4617a56106303fe.english: He was likely referring to the light he placed upon me.

c2b454906c0aec85af13d9e9d64557d4ce26a7f7.source:
だが、今回だけだろう。
続く階の守護モンスターにまで
通用するとは思えない。
c2b454906c0aec85af13d9e9d64557d4ce26a7f7.english:
Though, that will probably only work this once.
I doubt it will be effective against the guardian monsters
on the floors ahead.

a4a6e1946a2c47a2764a0dfbe6d153a5281740d3.source:
力試しはできなかったが、まあいい。
先へ進むぞ。
a4a6e1946a2c47a2764a0dfbe6d153a5281740d3.english:
I didn't get to test my strength, but no matter.
Let’s move on.

af383a68d8d1bbcbad2cb22105540d114265040a.source:
ねえ、覚えてる？
イグルがマダムに魔法を
かけたときに言っていたこと。
af383a68d8d1bbcbad2cb22105540d114265040a.english:
Hey, do you remember?
What Igul said when he cast that magic
on you, Madam?

5fde096315b15be71a7fdaff8b0799ea3d05822a.source:
「あなたは特別！」
「こちら側なのネ！」って……。
5fde096315b15be71a7fdaff8b0799ea3d05822a.english:
'You’re special!'
'You’re on our side!'...That’s what he said, right?"

820232db21be18ef34adbe6e7f7cd6deb1697e78.source:
ずっと気になっていたんだけど
「こちら側」って
どういう意味なんだろう？
820232db21be18ef34adbe6e7f7cd6deb1697e78.english:
I’ve been wondering about something...
What exactly does it mean
to be on “this side”?

57add2c0001e61e21678ee3d889b1a104691d455.source:
ごめんね。
あなただって訊かれても
わからないよね。
57add2c0001e61e21678ee3d889b1a104691d455.english:
Sorry.
You wouldn’t know the answer to that
any more than I would, would you?

57de10dad41afe1d12b8943d5138680053ec54f2.source:
ううん、気にしないで。
あたしたちも行こう。

900f9c3d0a0db367fe1de596715b2ce5105b3d49.english:
...So, you’ve arrived.
Just as I expected, it’s the “next door.”

b9a130456ca6ef5f128a3392b2937d40edb77555.source:
遺跡はこの先も続くってわけね。
マダムにとっては
物足りなかったかもしれないけど。
b9a130456ca6ef5f128a3392b2937d40edb77555.english:
So, the ruins continue beyond this point.
Though, I suppose this might have been
a bit underwhelming for you, Madam.

2497aa9036cce9d6da5bd152980fc086b4979ade.source:
いいや、今回の冒険も大いに楽しんだ。
次の石板が集まるまでの間くらいは
待ってやってもいいだろう。
2497aa9036cce9d6da5bd152980fc086b4979ade.english:
Not at all. I thoroughly enjoyed this adventure.
I don’t mind waiting a while,
until the next stone tablet is found.

f84e2ad940d5b1e4cc0b683f7aadea4ce338f38a.source:
私たちだけで踏破してしまったら
他の奴らがうるさいだろうしな。
f84e2ad940d5b1e4cc0b683f7aadea4ce338f38a.english:
If we were to explore the whole thing by ourselves,
the others would surely make a fuss.

8a9c4272139c69aa630b44270bef7e0ccc0d4fdc.source:
そうね。
今日はこの辺にしておきましょ。
8a9c4272139c69aa630b44270bef7e0ccc0d4fdc.english:
True enough.
Let’s call it a day, shall we?

5112e3056bf7647ca71852bda54d436eca7e2ecf.source:
はー、疲れた～！
帰ったらお風呂はいろっと！
5112e3056bf7647ca71852bda54d436eca7e2ecf.english:
Phew, I’m exhausted!
I can’t wait to take a bath when I get home!

d6013eeab56dd0b70da6d630b5d52183227dc28a.source:
朝に出発したはずだが、
今は夜かもしれないな。
d6013eeab56dd0b70da6d630b5d52183227dc28a.english:
We set off this morning, didn’t we?
It might well be night by now.

6cfbc821ce68340f1edfac1076e3c51b04b8227e.source:
ボウヤも疲れただろう。
今日は館で休んでいくといい。
美味いものを食わせてやるぞ。
6cfbc821ce68340f1edfac1076e3c51b04b8227e.english:
You must be tired too, kid.
Why not rest at the mansion tonight?
I’ll whip up something delicious for you.

6651d7f4bee7ad3aed03975ace4c3ec4282d4516.source:
アウィンとエルビスも呼んで
第二階層突破記念パーティーを
しなくちゃね！
6651d7f4bee7ad3aed03975ace4c3ec4282d4516.english:
We should invite Erwin and Elbis, too,
let’s have a party to celebrate
clearing the second stratum!

0dd57d65156b6d13f43ae6be0bcef4123800524f.source:
その日はマダムを始めとする
館の人間たちと、夜遅くまで
語り合い、友好を深めた。
0dd57d65156b6d13f43ae6be0bcef4123800524f.english:
That night, I stayed up late talking
with the Madam and the others at the
mansion, deepening our bonds of friendship.

d6bc7bb73f7f07c7ddb20d87b537ae206a6037ea.source: れでぃーすえーんじぇんとるめーん！

ceb7bed45c3c3b61a0d3f628ce149e5a3d919549.source:
我らが古代遺跡へようこそ！
ワタクシ案内を務めさせて
いただきます、イグルと申します！
ceb7bed45c3c3b61a0d3f628ce149e5a3d919549.english:
Welcome to our ancient ruins!
Allow me to be
your guide, my name is Igle!

f1ee64232c9b2971d77b7fe2f92df59eed1dab3d.source:
久方ぶりの来訪者に
胸をときめかせておりマスー！
f1ee64232c9b2971d77b7fe2f92df59eed1dab3d.english:
I’m so excited to have a visitor
after all this time!

6e31f26885b1e8e404c740b66275b16bfa5d2188.english:
A bird, again?
We certainly keep crossing paths, don't we?

fdc341276fbb0ecebdf0eb6643e676b6d215abdf.source:
奇遇なことに、私も胸を
ときめかせている真っただ中でな。
邪魔する奴は殴り飛ばすと決めている。
fdc341276fbb0ecebdf0eb6643e676b6d215abdf.english:
As it happens, I’m feeling quite
excited myself right now.
And I’ve decided to punch anyone who gets in my way.

4271355de042651f1d1729fbcc5e9dc28a55e7bb.source:
ちょ、ちょっと待っテー！
話を聞いて！　ここを無理やり通る
なんてできないんデスヨー！
4271355de042651f1d1729fbcc5e9dc28a55e7bb.english:
W-waita second!
Listen to me! You can’t just force your way
through here!

60378671ffa462363aa70625c18f6a1bd09733c9.source:
このフロアは、あらゆる“暴力”を封じ
あるひとつの能力を試すことで
来訪者が進むに値するか決めるのデス！
60378671ffa462363aa70625c18f6a1bd09733c9.english:
This floor suppresses all forms of “violence,”
and instead tests a specific ability
to see if a visitor is worthy of moving forward!

51a37e633dc417e89554c9cf3adb492b5e26539d.source:
あるひとつの能力！
それはズバリ“思考力”！！！
51a37e633dc417e89554c9cf3adb492b5e26539d.english:
A specific ability!
To put it simply: “Thinking skills”!!!

fd05bbef871aaff31d44ab52fd58557f31ea6530.source:
果たしてあなた方は無事に
このフロアを抜けられるでしょーカ！？
キョエー！　それでは問題ッ！
fd05bbef871aaff31d44ab52fd58557f31ea6530.english:
I wonder... will you all be able to make it through
this floor in one piece!?
Squawk! Time for a question!

3ec9412a4ad0e9194ad3ad049024bdd1730c22b6.source:
おい。誰がお前に
付き合ってやると言った？

da2b8ea9bcff9c60796901c03172ed989eaa3511.source:
『暴力を封じる』と言ったな？
確かに強い圧は感じるが、この通り、
鳥を黙らせる程度の力は出せそうだぞ？
da2b8ea9bcff9c60796901c03172ed989eaa3511.english:
You said 'violence is forbidden,' right?
I can certainly feel a heavy pressure here, but,
I think I can still muster enough strength to silence a bird, don't you?

814f3441d2b54efcbf998aedf2afb85915ea95fc.source:
キョエー！？　ナンテコッタイ！
あなたは特別！　こちら側なのネ！
814f3441d2b54efcbf998aedf2afb85915ea95fc.english:
Squawk, ?! Oh, my goodness!
You’re special! You’re one of us!

dbd02a7c0d279dbcbfc53727917d2fe95aae8fce.source:
──通行許可が発行されます。
案内役に危害を加えないでください。
dbd02a7c0d279dbcbfc53727917d2fe95aae8fce.english:
, Passage granted.
Please refrain from harming your guide.

350dcebdd8b667a6ab9fc9c029e1d4212a8d2579.source:
大丈夫だ、心配ない。
悪影響を起こす魔法じゃないな。
とは言え、良い効果とも限らないが。
350dcebdd8b667a6ab9fc9c029e1d4212a8d2579.english:
It’s alright, nothing to worry about.
It’s not a spell that causes any ill effects.
Though, that’s not to say it’s necessarily a *good* effect, either.

2756acb028a04fc0f23d6751824882e1298ef5e4.source:
この鳥！　イグル！
一体どういうこと？
マダムになにをしたの！
2756acb028a04fc0f23d6751824882e1298ef5e4.english:
You bird! Igle!
What on earth is going on here?
What did you do to Madam?!

fcecbf9d844f4e342883cab78b7d973ff695fc4a.source:
ワタクシなんにも知りまセン！
体が勝手に動いただけヨ！
fcecbf9d844f4e342883cab78b7d973ff695fc4a.english:
I don’t know anything about it!
My body just moved on its own!

f0041a0924d456c331a4434ad071d99f549c48cf.source:
どうやら、こちらの得になるものを
受け取ってしまったようだ。
f0041a0924d456c331a4434ad071d99f549c48cf.english:
It seems I’ve ended up with something
that works to my advantage.

8517f3eb2eeb9484c946c7e54fe66f30a36f14cf.source:
それが何かはわからないし、
強引ではあったが、相手の出す問題を
力でぶっ壊せなくなってしまったな。
8517f3eb2eeb9484c946c7e54fe66f30a36f14cf.english:
I’m not sure exactly what it is, and,
while it was a bit forceful, it means I can no longer
simply smash through the challenges presented to me with raw power.

d75eb4d187c2d93d6dd26eafce34438380668a94.source:
様子見も兼ねて
ここはおとなしく
奴の出すルールに乗ってやろう。
d75eb4d187c2d93d6dd26eafce34438380668a94.english:
For now, I’ll play along with the rules
they’ve set, if only to see
how things unfold.

32c398a615a5ab605e77eb54eeeee2bcb192ab74.source:
わかったわ。
あたしたちからすれば、マダムに
怪我がないならそれで充分よ。
32c398a615a5ab605e77eb54eeeee2bcb192ab74.english:
Understood.
As far as we’re concerned, as long as
you’re unhurt, Madam, that’s all that matters.

2de5abd8a4dab8576ac509ebb5825e12992c2d12.source:
やれやれ……。
この私がこんなにも
心配されるなんてな。
2de5abd8a4dab8576ac509ebb5825e12992c2d12.english:
Good grief...
To think that someone like me
would be the object of such concern.

a51c7a62782144762ca2bfe559af35814591cd48.source: この先から強い魔物の気配を感じる。<keywait>
a51c7a62782144762ca2bfe559af35814591cd48.english: You sense the presence of a powerful monster up ahead.<keywait>

2928d28ed97b8bfe7f3365a6c2b4714f801c2202.source: 思っていたより早かったな。

9d7d5a454b21d8e6ab1d1595e6078a10c248ff95.source:
ちょうどいい。私たちも
先ほどここに来たばかりだ。

0a58d36f5042b4651f7d56c255810fc4f017519e.source:
まずは
その石碑を確認してもらえる？
0a58d36f5042b4651f7d56c255810fc4f017519e.english:
Could you start by
checking that stone monument?

00528f1fd2f5dde8fe8f2486055a210d05d16cdc.source:
部分的に文字が
かすれて読めなくなっている。
00528f1fd2f5dde8fe8f2486055a210d05d16cdc.english:
Some of the text has
faded and is no longer legible.

2d584ce0a76447bbe9c9aaa6acf0f651924ae26d.source:
気づいたか？
前回と同じなら『罠の階』だ。
2d584ce0a76447bbe9c9aaa6acf0f651924ae26d.english:
Did you notice?
If it’s the same as last time, this is the ‘Floor of Traps.’

3c1923e680cb7283711904267875a7d7c220eab4.source:
第一層の『罠の階』にある石碑は
ちゃんと読めたんだよね？
3c1923e680cb7283711904267875a7d7c220eab4.english:
You were able to read the stone tablet on
the 'Trap Floor', the first level, right?

3e14e11000133ff4d519c0a6eb78ec628405e8f3.source:
確か『聖者の行進』だったな。
瘴気を振り払って進む、
その名の通りの仕掛けだった。
3e14e11000133ff4d519c0a6eb78ec628405e8f3.english:
If I recall, it was titled 'The Saint's Procession.'
It was a mechanism that lived up to
its name, you had to push through a miasma to advance.

8e65027f179c5c170951b478c9f9bd0336fe3ddc.source:
ということは……この石碑に部屋の
ヒントが書かれていたのか……残念。
8e65027f179c5c170951b478c9f9bd0336fe3ddc.english:
So that means...the stone tablet actually contained a hint
about this room, then...What a shame.

030c126e162e56158e6c11d93de0929945116349.english: Well, I suppose it depends on how you look at it.

0e98e65f9201a06d39f6b845f34f5513125c3f6d.source:
石碑にあべこべのヒントを記しておいて
それを読んだ侵入者をまったく別の
罠にかける作戦かもしれないし。
0e98e65f9201a06d39f6b845f34f5513125c3f6d.english:
Maybe they intentionally left a misleading hint on the tablet
as a ploy to lure intruders
into a completely different trap.

10b949ba5de2567f9737f158bd32ab83eb550ea8.source:
石碑の文字は故意に
削られたものではない。
風化によるものだ。
10b949ba5de2567f9737f158bd32ab83eb550ea8.english:
The text on the tablet wasn't deliberately scraped away.
It’s just weathered over time.

95b3022a491fe43f42d0c8cacd833b7e6209fe13.source:
この石碑は真実しか記されないだろう。
おそらく、本来は侵入者に向けて
作られたものでは──
95b3022a491fe43f42d0c8cacd833b7e6209fe13.english:
This stone monument likely records only the truth.
Perhaps... it wasn't originally
intended for intruders,

474006a94307406bfe8bfbc46e877841158c3f3f.source:
……いや、なんでもない。
お前の言う通りかもしれないな。
474006a94307406bfe8bfbc46e877841158c3f3f.english:
...No, never mind.
You might be right, after all.

8f62ab10071718321a62ecb831f984f0ab52a256.source:
実際、仕掛けは明確な殺意を持って
作られたものもある。この先も続くなら
侵入者の多くは命を落とすだろう。
8f62ab10071718321a62ecb831f984f0ab52a256.english:
In fact, some of these traps were clearly
designed with lethal intent. If this continues,
most intruders will likely lose their lives.

6373cc0a2ca04641c19fe1f5ad03516df59341d4.source:
とにかく、油断は禁物だ。
ここから先は固まって行動するぞ。
私と離れたら命の保障ができなくなる。
6373cc0a2ca04641c19fe1f5ad03516df59341d4.english:
Regardless, we must remain vigilant.
From here on out, we stay together.
If you stray from my side, I can no longer guarantee your safety.

fa33f142b60cd26dc6dddf288bccc586d3cdd731.source:
いやいや……マダムを守るために
この人がボディガードに
なってくれたんでしょ。
fa33f142b60cd26dc6dddf288bccc586d3cdd731.english:
Wait, hold on... Isn't this person supposed to be a bodyguard

to protect 'Madam'?

2c04e165a85c333853ad4c5222e2cfba145955fe.source:
ココにみっつの扉がアル！
どれかひとつが正解！
残りふたつが不正解！
2c04e165a85c333853ad4c5222e2cfba145955fe.english:
There are three doors here!
One of them is the right one!
The other two are wrong!

6ea018538a89c2b0010fb66577792ca686193f29.english: Well then! Go ahead and pick the right answer!

f687a105b7ed6ae61454f9a220dab3f518a5c4a5.source:
はあ！？
そんなのわかりっこないでしょ！
ただの運試しじゃない。
f687a105b7ed6ae61454f9a220dab3f518a5c4a5.english:
Huh!?
There’s no way to know that!
It’s just a game of chance, isn’t it?

7945c3b95319a7122289b4bd078fbf172582df38.source:
問題のヒントになるような
質問は一切受け付けまセーン！
7945c3b95319a7122289b4bd078fbf172582df38.english:
I won’t be accepting any questions that might
serve as hints to the puzzle!

8e75b1729bec44c747c508a2ee0e5bfa656105f3.source:
なんなのこの鳥！
無茶苦茶にもほどがあるわ！
8e75b1729bec44c747c508a2ee0e5bfa656105f3.english:
What is this bird, anyway?!
This is just way too unreasonable!

09d833cf7d3ce0780ec18b15a83a3acf440ce5bd.source:
問題のヒントにならない質問なら
受け付けるんじゃないのか？
09d833cf7d3ce0780ec18b15a83a3acf440ce5bd.english:
So, you *will* accept questions that
don’t provide any hints, right?

8d631355301daf98be290eab4d0cf63ba9c29f52.english: Silence means yes, then. Very well, I’ll ask.

f6f428a762126f195131a14df0a0bc7106f03584.source:
扉を選択して不正解だった場合、
解答者に対し、すぐに何かしらの
ペナルティが与えられるのか？
f6f428a762126f195131a14df0a0bc7106f03584.english:
If one chooses a door and it turns out to be wrong,
is there an immediate penalty
inflicted upon the person who answered?

8c20518807d678e046cb079e1d3f63e57cbe9dd1.source:
次の選択に移るだけデス。
解答者に危害は及びまセン。
8c20518807d678e046cb079e1d3f63e57cbe9dd1.english:
You simply move on to the next choice.
No harm will come to the person answering.

e932f78c79528d2db69832d8147136925b120410.source:
……なるほどね。
そこまで横暴じゃないか。
e932f78c79528d2db69832d8147136925b120410.english:
...I see.
So, not quite as overbearing as all that, then.

dc128b30380ccc1b574975f9bcd818f8c99784d8.source:
なら適当に選んでも変わらないよね。
マダム、どれにする？
dc128b30380ccc1b574975f9bcd818f8c99784d8.english:
In that case, it shouldn't matter which one I pick, right?
Madam,which one shall it be?

93073f3f0b7c811877a20c9f6eb47d8146634102.source:
この問題。
おそらく私では解けないだろう。
お前たちに任せる。
93073f3f0b7c811877a20c9f6eb47d8146634102.english:
This problem...
I likely won't be able to solve it.
I'll leave it to you all.

a970e4cee27deeb58babe5397a3f9dca33f186c2.source:
レキサ。お前になら解ける。
そして、私には
一生解けない問題だ。
a970e4cee27deeb58babe5397a3f9dca33f186c2.english:
Lexa. You’ll be able to solve it.
As for me...
I could never solve it, not in a lifetime.

7b7b20bb85143c66546313769d085f66a8b1e47f.source:
そんなのわからないでしょ。
まだ問題を聞いてもいないのに……。
7b7b20bb85143c66546313769d085f66a8b1e47f.english:
You don't know that for sure!
You haven't even told me what the problem is yet...

c3313a8c4261ece796f267709a2ce821523a23bf.source:
はやく選んデ！
遅いキンパツ遅い遅い！
c3313a8c4261ece796f267709a2ce821523a23bf.english:
Hurry up and choose!
You're too slow, Blondie, too slow, too slow!

d1a0fbe1e749853f1e70ffb955c330cc64db1cfd.source:
うっさいなぁ。
アンタ、マダムとあたしで
明らかに扱い違わない？
d1a0fbe1e749853f1e70ffb955c330cc64db1cfd.english:
Ugh, shut it.
Hey, don't you treat Madam
and me, like, totally differently?

9209582dd5dc1894e5970a32e6ac90219c05a5b0.english:
Whatever, though.
Alright then... The one on the right!

b258fe47c412e5effa2cc6e1fcf520562a2fbe47.source:
挑戦者は右を選択！
次の選択へ移りマス！
b258fe47c412e5effa2cc6e1fcf520562a2fbe47.english:
The challenger has chosen the right side!
Moving on to the next choice!

07ffa244d14eada2b7aa9461121814ed4ca05399.source:
次の選択って言われても
なにをやらせるつもりなんだろうね？
07ffa244d14eada2b7aa9461121814ed4ca05399.english:
They say 'next choice,' but
what exactly are they planning to make us do?

554883967aa21250dbdfab6352967b3dc7ca69b0.source:
なんと左の扉は不正解でしタ！
残りは右と真ん中のみデス！
どちらかが正解！
554883967aa21250dbdfab6352967b3dc7ca69b0.english:
Oh dear, the door on the left was the wrong answer!
That leaves only the right and the center!
One of them must be the right answer!

08c3b6e38122d1869ad70124ed976f96c8f67328.source:
あなたには再び
解答する権利が与えられマス！
さあ、右と真ん中どっちにしますカ！
08c3b6e38122d1869ad70124ed976f96c8f67328.english:
You are granted the right
to answer once again!
Well then, will it be the right or the center?

525c7cda2be81902a3a2b833305aa779ff9ffc22.source:
さしずめ、小手調べってところか。
だからマダムには解けないんだ。
あのとき、既に気づいてたの？
525c7cda2be81902a3a2b833305aa779ff9ffc22.english:
I suppose this is just a warm-up, then.
No wonder Madam couldn't solve it.
Did you already realize that back then?

8b451ab94e9bcc9c6ec95d8ceadf0228a335dec5.source:
レキサは気づいたようだ。
ならばこの問題、
ボウヤが挑戦してみるか？
8b451ab94e9bcc9c6ec95d8ceadf0228a335dec5.english:
It seems Lexa has noticed.
In that case, why don't you
give this puzzle a try, kid?

0dfd90d9aea118de669e8bd6c03602cda627a460.source: 蒼く輝く宝玉が台座に置かれている。<keywait>
0dfd90d9aea118de669e8bd6c03602cda627a460.english: A glowing blue gem rests upon a pedestal.<keywait>

b91e8d6d89ae0a93a8cb209ad14830fbbc2157eb.source: 宝玉を取り、探索を終了しますか？
b91e8d6d89ae0a93a8cb209ad14830fbbc2157eb.english: Take the gem and end your exploration?

93294c84200d63d751afb3407350a8186765ea87.source: ある酒場に旅人がやってきた。

d48f2431a5d8bce76fb8bbb627a9b8f3c8580231.source: 旅人は1万ギルをカウンターに置き、
d48f2431a5d8bce76fb8bbb627a9b8f3c8580231.english: The traveler placed 10,000 gil on the counter,

5f1a6391f41b60332a8ce084e5b006c7cfceb152.source: 酒場の主人はその金を掴んで店を出た。
5f1a6391f41b60332a8ce084e5b006c7cfceb152.english: and the tavern keeper took the money and left the establishment.

aca1ae8987560ee4871debdec5893a7610183787.source: 遠くで大きな物音がした……。<keywait>
aca1ae8987560ee4871debdec5893a7610183787.english: A loud noise echoed from somewhere far away...<keywait>

6665e3be72b24bff2a1f73380e45629d721c3aa1.source:
女は、酒場の主人にツケてもらっている
酒代として酒場のカウンターに置いた。
6665e3be72b24bff2a1f73380e45629d721c3aa1.english:
The woman had placed the money on the tavern counter
to pay off her outstanding tab for drinks.

0210994ab88417f9f366158be287a8cfd1098f3a.source:
さて、この1万ギルを
誰も使用していないにもかかわらず
関与した多くの人が笑顔になった。
0210994ab88417f9f366158be287a8cfd1098f3a.english:
Now, consider this: even though no one actually 'spent' that 10,000 gil,
everyone involved ended
up with a smile on their face.

99e7e99e4790a2f7cfd8fa11047133ee88590196.source:
酒場の主人は、
土地貸しにツケてもらっている
今月分の土地代の残りを払った。
99e7e99e4790a2f7cfd8fa11047133ee88590196.english:
The tavern keeper
paid the remaining balance of this month's land rent,
a debt he had been running up with the landlord.

b19ab7b6c1a1661e3bbb73e88c35651a2fc3b10b.source: 土地貸しはその金を掴んで店を出た。
b19ab7b6c1a1661e3bbb73e88c35651a2fc3b10b.english: The landlord took the money and left the establishment.

908acf214baa136d81bbaa8e677c478f5538702b.source:
土地貸しは、
賭場の男にツケてもらっている
負け分を支払った。
908acf214baa136d81bbaa8e677c478f5538702b.english:
The landlord used the
money to pay off his gambling debts, losses he had been
running up with a man from the gambling den.

8b84dbb2fadfdea6261ee44323151196b86c0af5.source: 賭場の男はその金を掴んで店を出た。
8b84dbb2fadfdea6261ee44323151196b86c0af5.english: The man from the gambling den took the money and left the establishment.

83d4e3c5f29973679c5a19491300d9f468fba5b9.source:
賭場の男は、
愛人の女に妻への口止め料を払った。
83d4e3c5f29973679c5a19491300d9f468fba5b9.english:
The man from the gambling
den paid his mistress, hush money to keep her from telling his wife.

33681ff08c02b6c2bdde73a5b5592a0a62f1193b.source: 女はその金を掴んで家を出た。
33681ff08c02b6c2bdde73a5b5592a0a62f1193b.english: The woman took the money and left the house.

e8a50ddfc8e264616b6e7f22a135e2e5d22b2485.source:
「717273」「777132」「237717」
どれが3で割り切れるか答えなさイ！
e8a50ddfc8e264616b6e7f22a135e2e5d22b2485.english:
“717273”“777132”“237717”
Tell me, which one is divisible by 3?!

05e2d1b3ad866445de717e2d973b92ae69c10da1.source:
あなたの解答『右の扉を除いた』
残り二つの扉の中から、
『不正解の扉』ひとつを消去しマス！
05e2d1b3ad866445de717e2d973b92ae69c10da1.english:
Your answer: “Excluding the door on the right...”
From the remaining two doors,
I shall eliminate one “incorrect” door!

ee418eb491d33390602cb52134f252b28402a996.source:
選んだ扉を変えないでアタリに辿りつく
確率の約33％より二倍も高いわ。
ee418eb491d33390602cb52134f252b28402a996.english:
If you don't change your chosen door, your chance of hitting the
winning one is about 33%, but switching gives you odds twice as high as that!

f204cb0a4b2c970fc74408ffc2f77643fd3c726d.source:
つまり、『選んだ扉を変更する』のが、
アタリとなる確率の最も高い“正解”に
なるわけね。
f204cb0a4b2c970fc74408ffc2f77643fd3c726d.english:
In other words, 'switching your chosen door'
is the 'correct' move, the one that gives you the highest
probability of winning.

944d528eb78ff522ca93a901d986051ca64b7094.source:
普通はみんなアタリを狙いにいくから
中々、答えに辿り着けないんだよね。
944d528eb78ff522ca93a901d986051ca64b7094.english:
Most people just try to pick the winner directly,
which is why they often fail to reach the right answer.

4b43f74354d9ab89c859bfe4d9e86da99a3f0052.source:
最初が、何千、何万の扉の数と
仮定すれば、もっとわかりやすいかな？
4b43f74354d9ab89c859bfe4d9e86da99a3f0052.english:
Maybe it would be easier to understand if we
imagined there were thousands or tens of thousands of doors to start with?

f4f7538b79785101e70de5cc02977586a1cd4ee4.source:
三分の一だと手が届きやすいっていうか
アタリそうな気がするもんね。
f4f7538b79785101e70de5cc02977586a1cd4ee4.english:
When it's just 'one in three,' it feels like
something you could easily guess right, doesn't it?

fb818bb2a1f5f343eef0e7554e86d9b68635bfd3.source:
……って、マダムの持っている大量の
本の中の一冊に書いてあったわ。
fb818bb2a1f5f343eef0e7554e86d9b68635bfd3.english:
...At least, that’s what was written
in one of the many books Madam owns.

3662f5b1b4b7dedd1a00b4031dd78db46c387e00.source:
こういうオモシロ知識って
どこで役に立つかわからないものよね。
3662f5b1b4b7dedd1a00b4031dd78db46c387e00.english:
You never know when a bit of
interesting trivia like this might come in handy, do you?

4286866fe9a845e21bff1bd60b79988c958d3096.english: Cat in Front of a Door

e7b4634f761820016c5c86a7ab22b431223d8603.source:
しばらくすると
視線の気配は消え去った……。
e7b4634f761820016c5c86a7ab22b431223d8603.english:
After a while,
the sensation of being watched faded away...

0914eb401563ef50369039534cc61e9bc39afb2b.source: どこからか視線を感じる。<keywait>
0914eb401563ef50369039534cc61e9bc39afb2b.english: You feel a gaze from somewhere.<keywait>

6dbe6dcc2163119a192c3616553a0774cd224d2b.source:
ペツォッタ。
気づいているか？

785cdb0377849599bce5fa033b44e91b4c029c9a.source:
ここはとんでもなく
モンスターの種類が豊富だな。
その昔、クリスタリスのとある遺跡で
仲間と冒険したことを思い出したよ。
ここと同じように
モンスターがうようよいてな。
そこで、あいつときたら──
……おっと、危ない。
無駄話をするところだった。
ボウヤは聞き上手だから
ついつい昔話をしたくなってしまうよ。
今は目の前の冒険に
集中しないとな。
785cdb0377849599bce5fa033b44e91b4c029c9a.english:
There’s an incredible variety of
monsters here, isn’t there?
It reminds me of an adventure I once had
with some companions in the ruins of Crystalis.
Just like here, the place was
crawling with monsters.
And back then, that guy,
…Whoops, watch out!
Almost got carried away with idle chatter.
You’re such a good listener, kid,
it makes me want to start sharing old stories.
Better focus on the adventure
right in front of us for now.

72ea746519c273b3a6488da59eea8febfa6979ef.source:
まさか遺跡の下に
魔物の町があるなんてな。
マダムはすでに順応してるが
俺は慣れるのに時間がかかりそうだ。
72ea746519c273b3a6488da59eea8febfa6979ef.english:
Who would’ve thought there’d be a
town of monsters beneath these ruins?
Madam’s taken to it just fine,
but it’s going to take me a while to get used to this.

0b324da8e4fe90eae69f94b542f4e3e941598065.source:
よう、お前ラ。ポテンシャの
ツレのペットなんだってナ。
心配すんナ。仲間のツレを
取っテ食ったリしねえよ。
0b324da8e4fe90eae69f94b542f4e3e941598065.english:
Hey, you lot. So, you’re the
pet of Potentia’s friend, huh?
Don’t worry, I’m not about to
go and eat a friend’s companion.

d5925edb4cc557fc2efce2d2d9d111093a173ee4.source:
特別ニ私の知識ヲ共有してあげよウ。
何か聞きたいことハあるかネ？
d5925edb4cc557fc2efce2d2d9d111093a173ee4.english:
I suppose I’ll share some of my knowledge with you.
Is there anything you’d like to ask?

861170623ebeaa28a957297c2058151b9f0295fb.source:
まもののくにデハ
ひとつノ法がアル。
『勝利者ガ守護モンスターニなれる』
という法がネ。
故ニどのモンスターも主様たちの役ニ
立てル守護モンスターヲ目指すンだ。
今はデーランボーというモンスターが
この階層ヲ守護してイる。
ずっとずっと昔ハ、ポテンシャが
守護モンスターだったんだガね……
861170623ebeaa28a957297c2058151b9f0295fb.english:
In the Land of Monsters,there is a single rule.The rule states that 'the victor may become a Guardian Monster.'
That is why every monster aspires to become a Guardian Monster, to be of service to you, Master.
Right now, a monster named Deranbo
serves as the guardian of this floor.
A long, long time ago, it was Potensha
who held the role of Guardian Monster...

827085784fca83cc3f8a08315db3b963a41eb319.source:
主様ノお役に立てル守護モンスターは
尊敬されル存在ダよ。
そのせイか、昔ノ守護モンスターである
ポテンシャを支持する者モ多い。
彼はデーランボーに負けタ後
ずっと逃げ続けているガね……。
皆、彼ガ傲慢なデーランボーを
倒してくレルと信じているんダよ。
827085784fca83cc3f8a08315db3b963a41eb319.english:
A Guardian Monster who proves useful to you, Master,
is a figure held in high esteem.
Perhaps because of this, many still support
the former Guardian Monster, Potensha.
Ever since he lost to Deranbo,
he has been on the run...
Everyone believes that he will one day defeat
the arrogant Deranbo.

eb418c51dc68b015581c01d40079380c5d2315a8.source:
「罠の階」というのガ
どういっタものかハわからンな。
まもののくにノ伝説となっていル
三つの謎ノことかな？
eb418c51dc68b015581c01d40079380c5d2315a8.english:
I’m not entirely sure what is meant by
the 'Floor of Traps.'
Could it be a reference to the 'Three Riddles'
that have become a legend in the Land of Monsters?

e10831b408fd01f95d614bf394a53f6603fc778a.source:
ナンダ？　オマエ？
ボム　ガ　ミズヲノンダラ
オカシイノカ？
e10831b408fd01f95d614bf394a53f6603fc778a.english:
What? Who are you?
Is it so strange for a Bomb
to drink some water?

9ba5f71d5b0cf84354eb4644ab2a2883e12ddcb1.source:
ここハ「まもののくに」。
モンスターが暮らす場所サ。
9ba5f71d5b0cf84354eb4644ab2a2883e12ddcb1.english:
This is the 'Land of Monsters.'
A place where monsters live.

e75019b3ea383be88f70328861d4e10df00f068a.source:
「まもののくに」の守護モンスターは
デーランボー様ダ。
あのお方ほド強いモンスターなド
この階層にハ存在しないゾ。
ポテンシャ？　誰ダそいつハ？
雑魚の名前など憶えてられんナ。
e75019b3ea383be88f70328861d4e10df00f068a.english:
The guardian monster of the 'Land of Monsters'
is Lord Deranbo.
There isn't another monster on this floor
as strong as him.
Potentia? Who’s that?
I don’t bother remembering the names of small fry.

33dba2f93b8d9ad3d672d8591d5417471a76fe8a.source:
オレはポテンシャ様モ
デーランボー様も認めテルゼ。
ドッチにせよ強い奴ガ
守護モンスターになればいいのサ。
33dba2f93b8d9ad3d672d8591d5417471a76fe8a.english:
I respect both Lord Potentia
and Lord Deranbo.
Either way, as long as someone strong
becomes the guardian monster, that’s all that matters.

01532d51472a39ca9d0e1d165863cf5ba713b2f7.source:
暗くてジメジメしたツボを探シ、
寝心地を確かめるンダ。
今日ハどのツボにしようかナ～。
01532d51472a39ca9d0e1d165863cf5ba713b2f7.english:
I’m looking for a dark, damp jar
to see how comfortable it is for sleeping.
Hmm, which jar should I pick for today?

d40ddd23be762d7b99e3c47e19c4177807f2b305.source:
元々、コノ階層はポテンシャ様ガ
守護モンスターだっタんだケド、
意地悪デめっぽう強イ
モンスターに負けちまっテね……。
その座ヲ奪われ、恐ろしい魔法デ
姿形まで変えられテしまったんだヨ。
d40ddd23be762d7b99e3c47e19c4177807f2b305.english:
Originally, Potentia-sama was the
guardian monster of this floor, but...
...she was defeated by a truly
vicious and incredibly powerful monster.
She lost her position, and he even used
dreadful magic to alter her very form.

67c2439df4237768a975f8196e436fa45e9be90b.source:
守護モンスターにはデーランボーよリ
ポテンシャ様ガ相応しい！
私ハずっと、言い続けてイル……。
以前ハ本当にそうだったノだガ……。
67c2439df4237768a975f8196e436fa45e9be90b.english:
Potentia-sama is far more suited to be the
guardian monster than Deranbo is!
I’ve been saying that all along...
And it really was the truth, once upon a time...

a6aecb7fb1de64a6ec7afbf2f416721831651f89.source:
この扉ノ向こうトこちら側ハ
守護モンスターだけガ行き来可能ニャ。
デーランボーはいつも
勝ち誇った顔デここヲ通るニャ……。
あちしハ悔しくてたまらないですニャ！
a6aecb7fb1de64a6ec7afbf2f416721831651f89.english:
Only the guardian monster is able to pass
back and forth through this door, nya.
Deranbo always passes through here
with such a smug, triumphant look on his face, nya...
It’s just so frustrating, nya!

1c8193f9d2336da00522d89e63f8c01986573600.source:
デーランボーは『大魔人』という
異名ヲ持つ強力なモンスターなのデス。
アナタタチも強そうデスが……。
彼の必殺技の前では無力でショウね。
1c8193f9d2336da00522d89e63f8c01986573600.english:
Deranbo is a formidable monster known
by the epithet 'The Great Demon.'
You all look quite strong, but...
I’m afraid you’d be powerless before his ultimate technique.

674144d829dbd3b67110264ffa977715bf9c8b75.source:
ポテンシャ様ハいつか
デーランボーを倒しテくれるチュ！
ポテンシャ様こソ第三階層最強ノ
モンスターなンだチュ！
ナゼナラ最強の能力の……。
えっと……何かヲ持ってたはずだチュ！
ただ、ソレがなんだったのかハ
ド忘れシてしまったチュ……！
674144d829dbd3b67110264ffa977715bf9c8b75.english:
Someday, Potensha-sama will
defeat Deranbo, chu!
Potensha-sama is the strongest
monster in the Third Stratum, chu!
Because he possesses the strongest ability...
Hmm... he’s supposed to have something, chu!
But I’ve completely forgotten
what it was, chu...!

ad440897074cd299a16124c9ff7492525c1fca2c.source:
そうだ。
この第三階層に
入り始めてからずっとな。
ad440897074cd299a16124c9ff7492525c1fca2c.english:
That’s right.
Ever since we entered
this Third Stratum.

b011e5a0bb4ead0a0d278ccf17f19347d4ec597d.source:
知能のある野郎が
俺たちを監視してるみてェだな。
b011e5a0bb4ead0a0d278ccf17f19347d4ec597d.english:
Looks like some intelligent fellow
is keeping an eye on us.

d3e366158ae7ea31e64029c7da69add85f5f9f65.source:
姿を現すつもりもないようだし
待っていても時間の無駄だろう。
d3e366158ae7ea31e64029c7da69add85f5f9f65.english:
Doesn’t look like they intend to show themselves,
so waiting around would just be a waste of time.

2af909aab31f0c8d3562e079af6ca6590de23365.source:
俺がやって構わねェなら
引き受けるぜ？
2af909aab31f0c8d3562e079af6ca6590de23365.english:
If you don’t mind me handling it,
I’ll take care of it, alright?

7c0acd0e3cebe532a846d7d2645613b48e4fa59b.source:
いや、気にするな。
好きなだけ監視させてやればいいさ。
7c0acd0e3cebe532a846d7d2645613b48e4fa59b.english:
No, don't worry about it.
Just let them keep watching as much as they like.

2754d24141c4b5e29b6af4ec084d76dc44432fdd.source:
私たちの前に立ち塞がったら
その時、首根っこを引っ掴んで
積もり積もった話を聞けばいい。
2754d24141c4b5e29b6af4ec084d76dc44432fdd.english:
If they ever stand in our way,
we can just grab them by the scruff of the neck
and have a long-overdue chat.

975183b51ce341cb3bdf3010b0a25be58e2182f9.source: そいつぁ、間違いの起こらねェ作戦だ。
975183b51ce341cb3bdf3010b0a25be58e2182f9.english: Now that’s a plan that can’t go wrong.

3b0829d4ae14a9a26c4ff41e4b55a086d5d22aa6.source:
ようやく一匹ニなったギャ！
覚悟するガいいんだギャ！
3b0829d4ae14a9a26c4ff41e4b55a086d5d22aa6.english:
That’s one down, pal!
You’d better brace yourself!

2cc2ca538721aea08c7eb5c644554984fe21cf02.source: 謎の魔物は逃げ去った……。<keywait>

812effd6c01d0863e18a9c9c14934db3b3ece4cf.source:
そろったな。
ボウヤのわりには珍しく
時間がかかったじゃないか。
812effd6c01d0863e18a9c9c14934db3b3ece4cf.english:
You’re all here, then.
That took longer than usual for you,
didn't it, kiddo?

60f3bd449ead732ee6b9799cfd32033365af0594.source:
なに？
おかしな魔物に襲われただと？
60f3bd449ead732ee6b9799cfd32033365af0594.english:
What’s that?
You were attacked by some strange monster?

b57b30697845979a6fd7cf94323093b48be1a2a6.source:
俺とマダムの前には現れてねェ。
ニィちゃんがひとりになるのを
狙っていたのかもな。
b57b30697845979a6fd7cf94323093b48be1a2a6.english:
It didn't show up in front of me or the Madam.
Maybe it was waiting for
you to be on your own.

7b690f806d0b46af912aef4d8bbfa60d866fe2e1.source:
監視はそいつの仕業か……？
だが、侵入者を排除したいなら
一対一で戦う理由がないな。
7b690f806d0b46af912aef4d8bbfa60d866fe2e1.english:
Could that thing be the one who was watching us...?
But if you want to eliminate an intruder,
there’s no reason to fight one-on-one.

1107a6fd21c18eb4fd4b2b1057cfc5f2ae960f1a.source:
なにか事情があるのかもな。
いずれにしても俺たちは
状況からの推測しかできねェぜ。
1107a6fd21c18eb4fd4b2b1057cfc5f2ae960f1a.english:
Maybe there’s more to it than meets the eye.
Either way, all we can do is
make guesses based on the situation.

50a17a4435861972e25a02960bb8a334934aa536.source:
まあいい。遺跡に棲息する魔物の
行動を理詰めで考えられるほど
私たちはこの場所に明るくはない。
50a17a4435861972e25a02960bb8a334934aa536.english:
Fair enough.We don’t know this place well enough
to logically deduce the behavior
of the monsters that inhabit these ruins.

f68c07388859173ec4a7d05e7c48e150ce82783e.source:
それよりも今は、そら。
第三階層の石碑だ。
目を通してみるといい。
f68c07388859173ec4a7d05e7c48e150ce82783e.english:
More importantly, look here.
It’s a stone tablet from the third stratum.
Take a look for yourself.

df1ba049d42aa66db4fa1a3e0b668d2b1c032f48.source:
俺もアウィンや
レキサの嬢ちゃんから
話は聞いているが──
df1ba049d42aa66db4fa1a3e0b668d2b1c032f48.english:
I’ve heard a thing or two from
Erwin and that
girl, Lexa, but...

ad66002dad0ef79f7b8b69d79b4908efcae87421.source:
この石碑に示されている
罠がどういうものなのか
見当もつかねェな。
ad66002dad0ef79f7b8b69d79b4908efcae87421.english:
I still have no idea what kind of traps
are being hinted
at on this tablet.

58b44e4982efd44e357396430fc522351c32cbea.source:
未知への挑戦は
冒険の醍醐味さ。
58b44e4982efd44e357396430fc522351c32cbea.english:
Facing the unknown,
that’s the real thrill of an adventure.

ce05add3f4f27bc4f3cf5a4b202272c5bb4db500.source:
第一階層や、第二階層に並ぶくらいの
驚きと高揚を期待しようじゃないか。
ce05add3f4f27bc4f3cf5a4b202272c5bb4db500.english:
Let’s hope for the same level of surprise and excitement
we found in the first and second strata.

b18dad0192ec7c92c6446d51049f704d684bdab5.source:
天井付近から
何者かの強い視線を感じる……。
b18dad0192ec7c92c6446d51049f704d684bdab5.english:
I can feel someone,
or something, staring intently from near the ceiling...

2cd854f2c29ae8b6544c90d0c4aecb9a30b05f67.source:
ニィちゃんも気づいたか。
……マダム。例の監視者が
“来る”みてェだ。
2cd854f2c29ae8b6544c90d0c4aecb9a30b05f67.english:
You noticed it too, kid?
...Madam.Looks like that 'watcher' of ours is...
...showing up.

64ce0c52cca1c1c550be4af0e8836e258ff31147.source:
ああ、わかってる。
私がやるから、お前たちは手を出すな。
64ce0c52cca1c1c550be4af0e8836e258ff31147.english:
Yes, I’m aware.
I’ll handle this, the rest of you stay out of it.

1637515a9fd9677d2bc8abfc10b74c11cff2726f.source:
ここデ会ったガ百年目！
覚悟し、
1637515a9fd9677d2bc8abfc10b74c11cff2726f.english:
At long last, our paths cross again!
Prepare yourself,

96f5d359310d40bafe7fae9eb0bcac3722ce69e2.source:
なんだこいつ？
とんでもなく弱いぞ？

28136049e6b7d9f9767da9c49f26043d8cdc3b56.english: Looks like it’s still breathing, at least.

66ebbf8aac6595318890cd7be4d598a01cc91754.source: ニィちゃんを襲ったのはこいつか？
66ebbf8aac6595318890cd7be4d598a01cc91754.english: Is this the one that attacked you, kid?

4434b9d0c5a30fc541d120270616a103592548a7.source:
なるほどな。
マダム、こいつはどうするんだ？
4434b9d0c5a30fc541d120270616a103592548a7.english:
I see.
Madam, what should we do with this one?

c3a92e6d0e2839859d7b84a58a92f01977a4e86a.source:
よし。
このまま放っておこう。

2c8a1e26f4b0641e2d22a68c6416c416b2b49664.source:
だとよ。良かったな。
命拾いしたみてェだぜ。
2c8a1e26f4b0641e2d22a68c6416c416b2b49664.english:
You heard her. Lucky you.
Looks like you’ve been granted a reprieve.

f932c43282e41c14282c293b8a227deaf14b236d.source:
ほう？
どうした？　もう一勝負するのか？

682256bb649550c5043bc8667e1af08811b840b1.source:
違うギャ！
そもそもオレの目的ハ
あんたたちニ勝つことでハないギャ！
682256bb649550c5043bc8667e1af08811b840b1.english:
That’s not it!
My goal wasn't to beat you guys
in the first place!

2e22f65c0ff5fd511685b0939252c54a30d8b221.source:
じゃあなんだ？　ずっと監視し続けてた
のもお前だろ？　上の階の鳥みたいに
私たちを罠にはめるためじゃないのか？
2e22f65c0ff5fd511685b0939252c54a30d8b221.english:
Then what is it? You’re the one who’s been
watching us the whole time, aren’t you? Like that bird
on the floor above, weren't you trying to lure us into a trap?

1427ff983e2dc252a8d46a34ce3144a7c0ced84f.source:
一目見て強者たちダト感じたギャ！
でも怖かったカラ……
1427ff983e2dc252a8d46a34ce3144a7c0ced84f.english:
At first glance, I could tell you were all strong!
But I was also scared...

4a9246835ce9ed9f33f956fd75611d660980d8d5.source:
弱そウな奴デ様子見しつつ……。
強さヲ推し測っテいたギャ！
4a9246835ce9ed9f33f956fd75611d660980d8d5.english:
I was watching from the sidelines, checking out the ones who looked weak...
...all while trying to gauge how strong you really were!

51ea34ee57a955bb9f2041a453652b46474ea697.source:
オレは強くなりたいんだギャ！
一緒ニ連れテいってくれギャ！
51ea34ee57a955bb9f2041a453652b46474ea697.english:
I want to become strong!
Please, take me along with you!

23b91460f7cf224140a563751495b3ff35bced28.source:
とんでもなく強い女の人！
そして、そのペット二匹！
23b91460f7cf224140a563751495b3ff35bced28.english:
An incredibly strong woman!
And those two pets of hers!

cca7a1b3df1d32aebca3d8a4a6d6f1c55ba4dc70.source:
誰がペットだ。
わからせるぞこの野郎。
俺は執事でそっちは護衛だ。
cca7a1b3df1d32aebca3d8a4a6d6f1c55ba4dc70.english:
Who are you calling a pet?
I’ll teach you a lesson, you little,
I’m a butler, and that one over there is a bodyguard.

9ad82e0768670198c23b765433ce7830c3a5c8cd.source:
あんたらガ何者でモ関係ないギャ！
とにカく強い！　そレだけデ十分ギャ！
9ad82e0768670198c23b765433ce7830c3a5c8cd.english:
It doesn't matter who you are!
The point is, you’re strong! That’s all that matters!

63cd065758dcc40419e0a110f473e08151e922dd.source:
あんたたちニついていけバ
きっとオレも変われるはずだギャ！
頼む！　連れテいってくれギャ！
63cd065758dcc40419e0a110f473e08151e922dd.english:
If I follow you all,
I’m sure I can change too!
Please! Take me with you!

66b070d225ef3d9b3026f27953ae342ff2c19625.source:
いいのか、マダム？
言葉を話せるとは言え、
こいつは魔物だぜ？
66b070d225ef3d9b3026f27953ae342ff2c19625.english:
Are you sure, Madam?
I mean, sure, it can talk,
but it’s still a monster, isn’t it?

b9474dbf6d384445805a2c869220bedd2792f855.source:
強さを求める気持ちが
本物であるならば
魔物も人も関係ない。
b9474dbf6d384445805a2c869220bedd2792f855.english:
If the desire to seek strength
is genuine,
it makes no difference whether one is a monster or a human.

3a7196d4515c012ad3684ede2f3f27bae1b49971.source:
種族や言語、趣味嗜好。
ドワーフ、妖精、獣人、エルフ。
そんなことはどうでもいい。
3a7196d4515c012ad3684ede2f3f27bae1b49971.english:
Race, language, personal tastes,
Dwarves, fae, beastkin, elves…
none of that matters.

feeb4514a93566b174bf436942df5af5c6e27c7a.source:
敵味方関係なく
私は真っすぐな奴が好きなんだ。
feeb4514a93566b174bf436942df5af5c6e27c7a.english:
Regardless of whether they’re friend or foe,
I have a soft spot for those who are straightforward.

a7f7f6b43df92391ce341ff5ac1f1ff63fb28fd2.source:
ああ、わかってる。
わかってるよ。
念のために聞いただけさ。
a7f7f6b43df92391ce341ff5ac1f1ff63fb28fd2.english:
Yeah, I know.
I get it.
Just thought I’d ask, that’s all.

1a7a883f1d2ef1c2b2e6760fd9430b2d226f6c76.source:
やった！　やったギャ！
これデあいつニ勝てるカモ
しれないギャ！
1a7a883f1d2ef1c2b2e6760fd9430b2d226f6c76.english:
Yes! Yes, *gya*!
Maybe now I can actually
beat that guy, *gya*!

4559fa752942bcb169d16aca1c331557218a91ff.source:
そうダ！　言い忘れテたギャ！
オレはポテンシャっていう名前ギャ！
覚えておいてくれギャ！
4559fa752942bcb169d16aca1c331557218a91ff.english:
Oh, right! I almost forgot to mention!
My name is Potentia!
Make sure you remember it!

b389053ea2dc8ab50b54b60c58ef8029346b2dd7.source:
ふーん、ポテンシャか。
ポテンシャ、ポテンシャ……。

678b87d883ac40a20e285794550ff36bfc3d8ad1.source:
ギャギャギャ！　オレもずっと
そう思っテ生きてきたギャ！
678b87d883ac40a20e285794550ff36bfc3d8ad1.english:
Hahaha! I’ve thought the exact same thing
my whole life!

8d93746e2d297f88cf8d02e7d17da7407d48ff1c.source:
けど悪くないぞ。
お前の名前、気に入った。
もう忘れることはないだろうな。
8d93746e2d297f88cf8d02e7d17da7407d48ff1c.english:
Still, it’s not bad at all.
I’ve taken a liking to your name.
I don’t think I’ll be forgetting it anytime soon.

12e0312baffd8039ff76e9cf1e466401d273cc1c.source:
うれしいこと言っテくれるギャ！
あんたハなんていう名前だギャ？
12e0312baffd8039ff76e9cf1e466401d273cc1c.english:
That’s so kind of you to say!
And what’s your name?

2cb8c4a6a397e0db8977cee50490e72369913d7b.source:
私か？　そうだな……。
皆、私のことをマダムと呼ぶ。

92c73ca5e5e568d306e9c666d8625787b1c65ce6.source:
マダム！　強そうな名前だギャ！
さあ、コッチだギャ！
この先ヲ案内するギャ！
92c73ca5e5e568d306e9c666d8625787b1c65ce6.english:
Madam! That sounds like a powerful name!
Right, follow me!
I’ll show you the way!

adc9f79699095cc4e35f18bc42c1dc7a9e3cd576.english: But... that’s just the kind of person he is.

0f62a28a92402062ce7df665a41625fb0ab4ede4.source:
さっきまで敵同士だったってのに
もう仲良くなってやがる。
笑っちまうよな。
0f62a28a92402062ce7df665a41625fb0ab4ede4.english:
We were enemies just a little while ago,
and now he’s already gotten chummy with everyone.
It’s almost funny, isn’t it?

ba5bb6d7cb943e1027ef0d174759cb55d2b41d7a.source:
マダムがいなきゃ、俺とニィちゃんが
出会うこともなかったわけだしな。
そう思うと、感慨深いぜ。
ba5bb6d7cb943e1027ef0d174759cb55d2b41d7a.english:
If it weren’t for Madam, you and I
would never have even met.
When you think about it that way, it’s quite moving.

b5f237a5814b3d97edbc0d266a406ac429bb514b.source:
……悪ィな。
つまんねェ雑談だった。
先を急ごうぜ。
b5f237a5814b3d97edbc0d266a406ac429bb514b.english:
...My bad.
That was some pointless chatter.
Let’s keep moving.

0d091731d8ed6fee1c73220168a26b9748c25696.source:
おいおい、冗談だろ。
もしかしてこの場所……。
0d091731d8ed6fee1c73220168a26b9748c25696.english:
Whoa, whoa... you’ve got to be kidding me.
Could this place actually be...

820217695ad5da61aee852b9c4682e6f278b2ff7.source:
モンスターが
暮らす町……なのか……？
820217695ad5da61aee852b9c4682e6f278b2ff7.english:
A town where
monsters live... is that it...?!

6dbf5b81da6f8a858c2c903dfd0f6c3e198d7bf2.source:
そうだギャ？
なにか疑問ガあるのギャ？
6dbf5b81da6f8a858c2c903dfd0f6c3e198d7bf2.english:
That’s right, gya!
You got a problem with that, gya?

3dc574d2b84c7ca7a7ec361e9846c1ab76804852.source:
ポテンシャ様！　お帰りチュ～。
戻ったノ三日ブリくらいかチュ？
3dc574d2b84c7ca7a7ec361e9846c1ab76804852.english:
Potensha-sama! Welcome back, chu~!
It’s been about three days since you were last here, hasn’t it, chu?

6d2d3934d457c591b3d82b10593c4a2d3002b24c.source:
それぐらいかギャ。
変わりナイようデ安心したギャ。
6d2d3934d457c591b3d82b10593c4a2d3002b24c.english:
I suppose it has, gya.
Glad to see everything’s still the same, gya.

960e6d69fd1ae16d2ff746211563907b202c931c.source:
今日ハまだ
デーランボーは来てないチュ。

16cdee3f98846c0db54efc57ebb537657086a0f0.source:
ポテンシャ様。
いつデーランボーにリベンジするチュ？
16cdee3f98846c0db54efc57ebb537657086a0f0.english:
Potensha-sama…
When are you going to get your revenge on Deranbo, chu?

80c0b6c6f637ab8e2a7a8e9f991c1b9897dc8e0d.source:
あいつヲとっちめてくれるのヲ
楽しみニしてるチュ～。
80c0b6c6f637ab8e2a7a8e9f991c1b9897dc8e0d.english:
I’m really looking forward to you
giving that guy a good thrashing, chu~!

9fc2f72c89755188fb96e269716e1ab589c9b4bd.source:
生まれたときからここに住んでりゃ
疑問なんてあるわけねェか……。
9fc2f72c89755188fb96e269716e1ab589c9b4bd.english:
I guess if you’ve lived here since birth…
you wouldn’t really have any questions about it, would you…?

a9f664b908a9fd04248ecfa2fcaeabb1cc7d34ea.source:
ハハハ！　だがこいつは面白いぞ！
早速、暮らしている奴らに
話を聞いてみよう！
a9f664b908a9fd04248ecfa2fcaeabb1cc7d34ea.english:
Hahaha! But this is interesting!
Let’s go ask the folks who live here
what they have to say!

7f6b6ef3d3ae1d1d2e8fc3428ac23779d232f898.source:
ほう。三つの謎ニ興味がおありカ？
ヨロシイ。教えてしんゼよウ。
ヒトツ。『恐怖の口』ハ
体力と魔力ヲ吸い続ける。
信じる力ヲ持つ真ニ強き者以外デは
その吸収ニ耐えられないだろウ。
しかし、その先ヘ進みたくバ
『恐怖の口』ヲ攻略する以外にナシ。
フタツ。『死の谷』ハ
進む者みナ、屍ト変えル。
勇気の力なくシて
死の谷は越えラれぬであろウ。
ミッツ。『不壊の水晶』ハ
どんな攻撃ヲも無力化すル。
故に、その中ニ地下へ進むためノ
扉を開く『鍵』を保管スル。
諦めナい心を持ツ者でなけレば
破壊すること永久ニ叶わぬだろウ。
以上だナ。もう一度
聞きたくなったラまた来なサイ。
7f6b6ef3d3ae1d1d2e8fc3428ac23779d232f898.english:
Hmm. So, you’re interested in the three mysteries, are you?
Very well. I shall tell you about them.
First: the 'Maw of Terror',
it continuously drains one’s vitality and magical power.
Unless one possesses the power of faith, a mark of the truly strong,
one would surely succumb to this drain.
Yet, if you wish to proceed further,
you have no choice but to conquer the 'Maw of Terror'.
Second: the 'Valley of Death',
it turns all who enter into mere corpses.
Without the power of courage,
none can hope to cross the Valley of Death.
Third: the 'Indestructible Crystal',
it renders any and all attacks completely ineffective.
For this reason, it houses the 'key',
the means to open the door that leads to the depths below.
Unless one possesses an unyielding heart that refuses to give up,
it shall remain forever impossible to shatter.
That is all. Should you wish to hear it again,
do feel free to return.

e7ae1bc21e2ac1cbe4f72abcb64db01c6602602d.source:
この扉、びくともしないな。
どうやら守護モンスターとやら
だけが通過できるらしい。
なんとかして
先へ進む手段を探さないとな。
e7ae1bc21e2ac1cbe4f72abcb64db01c6602602d.english:
This door won’t budge an inch.
It seems that only the so-called 'guardian monsters'
are permitted to pass through.
I’ll have to find some other way
to move forward.

1eb31c8b7da5e009966aebbda19e26bc989b7670.source:
この先へ進むためには
ひと山超えないといけないらしいな。
町の誰かが扉を開ける方法を
知っているかもしれねェ。
ニィちゃん。
ちょいと探りを入れてみてくれるか？
1eb31c8b7da5e009966aebbda19e26bc989b7670.english:
Looks like we’ll have to get over a mountain
if we want to move any further.
Maybe someone in town knows
how to open that door.
Hey, kid.
Could you go and see what you can find out?

883e464e4f6d114165dc38ab8edf65a20811d5fe.source: デーランボーが来タぞーーー！！！

9f6246f8c5969b06dd23dc2e2c5f374c4af557d9.source:
巨大なモンスターの前に
町のモンスター達が集まっている……。
9f6246f8c5969b06dd23dc2e2c5f374c4af557d9.english:
The monsters of the town have gathered
before a colossal monster...

0ee59a8d10511df71c7edae199fb3ae82daf26d9.source:
な、なにしニ来たんだチュ！
また力試しト言って虐めル気かチュ！？
0ee59a8d10511df71c7edae199fb3ae82daf26d9.english:
W-w-what are you here for!?
Are you going to bully us again, calling it a 'test of strength'!?

7249002d08ff3f1ee154b53ebea9ddeb8dee64e1.source:
ふん、あれハ鍛錬のヒトツよ。
貴様たちノような弱者にハわからんか。
7249002d08ff3f1ee154b53ebea9ddeb8dee64e1.english:
Hmph.That is merely a form of training.
I suppose weaklings like you wouldn't understand.

082eb8a0bf43ed399d5760efabf3e73a30f8ea7f.source:
このようナ場所で鍛錬もセズ
ただ漫然と生きていル下賤の輩にはな。
082eb8a0bf43ed399d5760efabf3e73a30f8ea7f.english:
Especially not the likes of you,
wretches who live aimlessly, without ever training.

3592e0862618caed58cdf927822e4e72abe8d121.source:
ナニヲ言う！
お前ガ来るたび、俺たちハ
ヒドイ目にあわサれテいるんだゾ！
3592e0862618caed58cdf927822e4e72abe8d121.english:
What are you talking about!?
Every time you show up,
we end upsuffering terribly!

0cae1df43a5351cd220f8f8c79d311401c444b33.source:
こんナことナラ……。
やはりポテンシャ様ガ守護モンスターで
あるべきなんダ！
0cae1df43a5351cd220f8f8c79d311401c444b33.english:
If that’s the case…
Then surely, Potentia-sama should be the
guardian monster after all!

327c3c1e98dd29ec4b8f90c7455f4d909158c803.source:
奴はただノ臆病者！
ソノ証拠に、奴ガ我に敗北した後
姿を見せたコトは一度もナイだろう！
327c3c1e98dd29ec4b8f90c7455f4d909158c803.english:
That wretch is nothing but a coward!
For proof of that, has he even shown
his face once since his defeat at my hands?

199a5fe00b00eef48aaff11b4b568b5cc5906313.source: きっと、力ヲ蓄えているところデ……。

fb151d9f54f2237f2a16a283b2c6a0d5afd0b134.source:
そんナ雑魚のことヲ
いまだニ信じていルのか？
馬鹿メ！　腹がヨじれテしまウわ！
fb151d9f54f2237f2a16a283b2c6a0d5afd0b134.english:
You still believe in a weakling like that?
You fools! You’re making me laugh until my sides ache!

b1cbf8dad3e4328b483675aa934453f2d1f6b150.source:
この階層デ最も強いのハ我だ！
お前たちハ我の言うことヲ聞けばヨイ！
b1cbf8dad3e4328b483675aa934453f2d1f6b150.english:
I am the strongest on this floor!
All you need to do is listen to what I say!

75ee2f05ca48bed8925210bbd071609614c637cb.source:
文句ガあるなら力デ示せ！
弱者のままならお前たちハ
路傍ノ石でしかないノだ！
75ee2f05ca48bed8925210bbd071609614c637cb.english:
If you have any complaints, prove it with your strength!
If you remain weak, you’re nothing more than
a stone by the roadside!

ae4e84fbafc6d04a40df118c20d506b662a62fd2.source:
モンスターたちは
静まり返ってしまった……。

d03e0e331339a24e039994483b899c4a0cb1a46a.source:
ポテンシャなどというクズの
話ハ二度とスルな！
奴ハ臆病者の能無しナノだからな！
d03e0e331339a24e039994483b899c4a0cb1a46a.english:
Don’t you ever bring up that piece of trash, Potenza, again!
He’s nothing but a cowardly, good-for-nothing loser!

4237dc4a118c7c75dec6ec7ec42f0592c1166166.source:
お前がなぜ強くなりたいって
思っているのかってのもな。
4237dc4a118c7c75dec6ec7ec42f0592c1166166.english:
And as for why you
want to become stronger...

ca37e9b52630e160c78fee5669f245b0a992d1c9.source:
……そうだギャ。
あんたたちノ考えていル通りだギャ。

92d40ad4f0fb5e0fc1b6a8c1416bc029efd81986.source:
オレはデーランボーに負けテ以来
一度モ再挑戦してないギャ。
92d40ad4f0fb5e0fc1b6a8c1416bc029efd81986.english:
Ever since I lost to Deranbo,
I haven’t even tried to challenge him again.

c111b70c03e217757b2cbf9bccccaf1fab0b1633.source:
魔法デこんな姿ニ変えられて……。
他ノ奴に言い訳しながラ
逃げ続けテいるんだギャ……。
c111b70c03e217757b2cbf9bccccaf1fab0b1633.english:
I was transformed into this state by magic...
and I’ve just been running away ever since,
making excuses to everyone else...

34d4e8399a52fe9feb8ec5098bd187168fd40a21.source:
デーランボーの姿を見るト
負けた時ノことヲ思い出しテ……。
全身ガ震えてしまウんだギャ……。
34d4e8399a52fe9feb8ec5098bd187168fd40a21.english:
Whenever I see Deranbo,
I remember the moment I lost...
and my whole body starts to tremble...

5b567c99cd17dadd796cad7c54019d2379063132.source:
だかラ！　強さノ秘訣ヲ
知りたくテ、マダムたちニ
ついテきたんだギャ！
5b567c99cd17dadd796cad7c54019d2379063132.english:
That’s why!　I wanted to learn the secret to your strength,
so I tagged along
with you ladies!

ccabd191e0c0486d1b1545330761d5ff0edaca73.source:
……そうか。
ならばひとつ、言っておく。
ccabd191e0c0486d1b1545330761d5ff0edaca73.english:
...I see.
In that case, let me tell you one thing.

38c0e111976dba4d567c9a3fe98a694fb6648541.source:
今のままなら
お前は絶対に奴には勝てん。
38c0e111976dba4d567c9a3fe98a694fb6648541.english:
As you are now...
you have absolutely no chance of defeating him.

3e9c2402a2d57926534ede531864b8a048f234a5.source:
ワカってるギャ！
だかラこうしてマダムに
ついていって強さノ秘訣ヲ──
3e9c2402a2d57926534ede531864b8a048f234a5.english:
I know that, ya!
That’s why I’m tagging along with
Madam, to learn the secret to becoming stronger...

606fcb92749a629d99cc052e595992b50c456be3.source:
いいや。
お前は何もわかっていない。

16fb2d525c53eb0e320f6854a23d08ef83614731.source:
答えを与えたところで
理解もできんだろう。
16fb2d525c53eb0e320f6854a23d08ef83614731.english:
Even if I gave you the answer...
you wouldn’t be able to grasp it.

aef294fad80ba79b5f01bec2b5a5f027beb2a440.source:
先ニ進むのかギャ！？
もしかしてデーランボーとも
戦うツモリなのかギャ！？
aef294fad80ba79b5f01bec2b5a5f027beb2a440.english:
Are you moving forward, ya?!
Don’t tell me you’re planning
to fight Deranbo too, ya?!

e85fccf7cc5d9953271bb8718dfbee762243c8a6.source:
奴がこの階層を守る
守護モンスターなんだろう？
だったら当然、戦って倒すさ。
e85fccf7cc5d9953271bb8718dfbee762243c8a6.english:
He’s the guardian monster for this floor, isn’t he?
Then, naturally, I’ll have to fight and defeat him.

cad421d7b834a31264aabaf85ef7482fcde7e359.source:
無理だギャ！
あいつハとんでもないんだギャ！
cad421d7b834a31264aabaf85ef7482fcde7e359.english:
It’s impossible!
That thing is on a whole other level!

bf69d62727c57cbe3ea060e212d8c8733f03a34f.source:
そんじょそこラのモンスターとハ
ワケが違うんだギャ！
勝てルわけないギャ！
bf69d62727c57cbe3ea060e212d8c8733f03a34f.english:
It’s not like any ordinary monster!
There’s no way you can win!

68fd414a737e28c704831b80cf8cf95705dc9444.source: お前の“無理”を私に押しつけるな。
68fd414a737e28c704831b80cf8cf95705dc9444.english: Don’t project your own sense of 'impossibility' onto me.

b4a8b366cc5cdc572a3a623617139ebbda555089.source:
お前たちはデーランボーの強さヲ
知らないカラそんなことヲ
言えるンだギャ……。
b4a8b366cc5cdc572a3a623617139ebbda555089.english:
You only say things like
that because you don’t know
how strong Deranbo is...

79c11b23d2ae1572a8e2d41bb10846a568c826e1.source:
わからナいなラ、
逃ゲ出すのガ正解だギャ……。
79c11b23d2ae1572a8e2d41bb10846a568c826e1.english:
If you don’t know,
then running away is the right choice...

ea6ac90a812d9e52701ffc82935d299a2da35b3d.source:
いや……オレは思ったンだギャ。
マダムからハ何か大切ナものを
学べル気がスルって……。
ea6ac90a812d9e52701ffc82935d299a2da35b3d.english:
Well... I got to thinking...
that maybe I could learn something
important from you, Madam...

41d5232d8e79da9ba0c016ff1e2f2af1c553de4a.source:
お前たちノ強さノ秘訣。
オレの目デ確かめテやるんだギャ。
41d5232d8e79da9ba0c016ff1e2f2af1c553de4a.english:
The secret behind your strength.
I’m going to see it for myself with my own eyes.

96ffa7b94e57a5546b3ceba33c15a285ad3987c6.source: ハッハッハ！　くだラんな！

93a6272a0dc656db80b247105564b386c0dbeaeb.source:
お前モ、デーランボーと戦っテ
勝てるト思っているのかギャ？
93a6272a0dc656db80b247105564b386c0dbeaeb.english:
Do you really think you can fight Deranbo
and win?

c4e304e85b3c13fd3f90212c1189f50c2a05eea7.source:
クカカ！　わかれバよい！
我だけガ主様ノご期待に
沿う力ヲ持ってイルのだ！
c4e304e85b3c13fd3f90212c1189f50c2a05eea7.english:
Kukaka!　You’ll see soon enough!
I am the only one who possesses the
power to live up to our Master’s expectations!

bbd9da8dc87cd7c15c65998d22746acc31b294dc.source:
ポテンシャ。
大体の経緯はわかったぜ。
bbd9da8dc87cd7c15c65998d22746acc31b294dc.english:
Potentia.
I think I’ve got the gist of the situation now.

aa7a2f4a68fcac9e49c82d3e63f2cecac46fd056.source:
三つの謎ってやつが
先へ進む、文字通りの鍵ってわけだな。
aa7a2f4a68fcac9e49c82d3e63f2cecac46fd056.english:
So, these 'three mysteries',
they’re literally the keys to moving forward, huh?

5cd6731f423c7e8576b40ceb718b45cf5d5eda13.source:
恐ろしい姿をした物体が
壁に埋め込まれている。
5cd6731f423c7e8576b40ceb718b45cf5d5eda13.english:
An object with a terrifying appearance
is embedded in the wall.

e12ebdbb5875857094f0f22e29715b9d1407002d.source:
鉄格子は固く閉ざされている。
なんらかの仕掛けによって
開く仕組みになっているようだ。
e12ebdbb5875857094f0f22e29715b9d1407002d.english:
The iron gate is firmly shut.
It appears to be designed to open
via some sort of mechanism.

d851c82c50b7965f3c85ce7d8e948be5bf38e943.source: ペツォッタが扉に鍵を差し込んだ。
d851c82c50b7965f3c85ce7d8e948be5bf38e943.english: Pecciotta inserted a key into the door.

f8e6c25f6c1e7a10d6e1d5376a2e9697a9a844fc.source:
扉は固く閉じられている。
特殊な『鍵』によって
施錠されているようだ。
f8e6c25f6c1e7a10d6e1d5376a2e9697a9a844fc.english:
The door is firmly shut.
It seems to be locked
with a special 'key'.

53b8b984da96a5783833becee5b788df5b13a1ee.source:
この程度、なんの問題もない。
お前たちはさっさと行ってこい！
53b8b984da96a5783833becee5b788df5b13a1ee.english:
Something like this is no problem at all.
You lot, get going already!

c575eb81cbea7b1ca4e52045b76d71310ad72d9b.source:
ここが三つの謎のひとつ。
『死の谷』だろうな。
c575eb81cbea7b1ca4e52045b76d71310ad72d9b.english:
So this is one of the three mysteries,
the 'Valley of Death,' I suppose.

6fa7684d67852a6ac6542d87fae2be9eb5f9e667.source:
どんナ者であってモ
死の谷ヲ渡り切れズ
屍ニなると言われテいるギャ。
6fa7684d67852a6ac6542d87fae2be9eb5f9e667.english:
They say that no matter who you are,
you won't make it across the Valley of Death,
you'll just end up a corpse, they say!

e53812091b7e384034ef91487d3d301aacb429d5.source:
面白ェ。
ちょいと行ってくるぜ。

65e8051f1b032bb77352a71686e022c239cc7fce.source:
本気なノかギャ！？
マダムもあんたも……
オレにハ理解できんギャ！
65e8051f1b032bb77352a71686e022c239cc7fce.english:
Are you serious!?
Both you and Madam...
I just don't get it!

3168b107e8c75227eca74ff923db6156cfea80d6.source:
だったらそれが
お前が必要とする力の
正体なのかもな。
3168b107e8c75227eca74ff923db6156cfea80d6.english:
In that case, maybe that’s the
true nature of the power
you’re looking for.

0afd93ba908dd9632b5d95277e480ac66312afe5.source: グダグダ喋ってるヒマはねェ。

c0ec72d2c314e4a94bdf839e98c2949a0879a5c4.source:
ふん……！
質より量の罠なんかで
この俺をやれると思うんじゃねェ。
c0ec72d2c314e4a94bdf839e98c2949a0879a5c4.english:
Hmph...!!
Don't think you can take me down
with some trap that relies on quantity over quality.

539d222b5271bb79c2f59cf2123a2487b9e4edc9.source: 固く閉ざされていた扉が開いた！

b5ef645fdf9c49f68b3ce2c4330230a1b527a34d.source:
おそらくは、それぞれの仕掛けを
クリアしなければ守護モンスターの
部屋には行けない仕組みだろう。
b5ef645fdf9c49f68b3ce2c4330230a1b527a34d.english:
It seems that
we won't be able to reach the guardian monster's room
unless we clear each of these mechanisms.

3a2ea2891da706112a6ea0565b4a18b4ba9a7de4.source:
そのひとつめが
体力と魔力を吸収する
『恐怖の口』……か。
3a2ea2891da706112a6ea0565b4a18b4ba9a7de4.english:
And the first one is...
the 'Maw of Terror,'
which drains both HP and MP... is it?

a18232a1cd6f06362600d6eed4c6f4f74e04d681.source:
命知らずナ魔物たちガ
挑戦したことモあるギャ。
a18232a1cd6f06362600d6eed4c6f4f74e04d681.english:
Some reckless
monsters have tried it, too.

e4852d8f4f5c7d3be86223303cfc455c1f7c3658.source:
ケド、１０数えるうちにハみんな
恐怖の口かラ手や足ヲ抜いたギャ。
e4852d8f4f5c7d3be86223303cfc455c1f7c3658.english:
But...before they could even count to ten, they all
pulled their limbs out of that 'Maw of Terror.'

c4e73fb48dafcbca919faeda51bd32aa706bb30b.source:
とんでもないスピードで
力ガ抜けていくギャ。
耐えられル奴なんていないギャ。
c4e73fb48dafcbca919faeda51bd32aa706bb30b.english:
Your strength drains away
at an incredible speed.
No one can endure it.

eff815266b8030e5956e9ee24cb04c3d86ed83ae.source:
奥の鉄格子は
こいつに手を入れている間
開いた状態になる、というわけか。
eff815266b8030e5956e9ee24cb04c3d86ed83ae.english:
So, the iron gate further in
stays open as long as you
keep your hand inside this thing, is that it?

f293524598b9e72efb605c5f0ddf304300640207.source:
だから町ノ誰もが一度ハ挑戦しても
二度と試したリしないんだギャ。
f293524598b9e72efb605c5f0ddf304300640207.english:
That’s why, even if someone in town tries it once,
they never try it a second time.

19347fae30c42cf5d672eacedf6e0eb9a46b2b12.source:
なるほどな。つまり、一度恐怖の口に
腕を突っ込んで、鉄格子を開いたら
そのままの状態でいなければならない。
19347fae30c42cf5d672eacedf6e0eb9a46b2b12.english:
I see.In other words...once you stick your arm into the 'Maw of Terror'
and open the iron gate,
you have to keep it there.

63b3aa5b23f3760a25e2136b0c26d7590acef411.source:
当然、腕を入れている間は
体力と魔力を吸われ続けるわけだ。
63b3aa5b23f3760a25e2136b0c26d7590acef411.english:
Naturally...as long as your arm is inside,
your stamina and magic power keep getting drained away.

10d87471c02fdae11ad3376c6e199f3c33800a9a.source:
……やれやれ。
面白い罠を作るものだな。
10d87471c02fdae11ad3376c6e199f3c33800a9a.english:
...Good grief.
Quite an ingenious trap they’ve come up with.

70ad39679ce505342257dfb3813eba2cdd87b468.source:
そ、そいつラは
一体どうやったんだギャ？
70ad39679ce505342257dfb3813eba2cdd87b468.english:
Th-those guys...
how on earth did they pull that off, gya?

641f0f50037f566851cca6d5fab5e9da7c2fe902.source:
な、なにしてるンだギャ！？
早ク抜くギャ！　いくらマダムでモ
耐えられるモノではないギャ！
641f0f50037f566851cca6d5fab5e9da7c2fe902.english:
W-w-what are you doing?!
Pull it out, quick! Even for a 'Madam' like me,
this is more than I can take!

d67180357f44298f8e51520c30c3a8bb41192522.source:
どうだ、私の力は旨いだろ？
いくらでもくれてやる！
吸い尽くせるなら吸い尽くしてみろ！
d67180357f44298f8e51520c30c3a8bb41192522.english:
Well? My power, it tastes good, doesn't it?
I’ll give you as much as you want!
Go ahead, try and drain me dry!

a38332ac242fce411ae7197fe4660486fce82cb6.source:
あ、開イたギャ！？
初めテ見たギャ……！

c36d88c0ab674e146d880f036271b4b6b093e4ff.source:
ボウヤ！　ペツォッタ！
この先はお前たちで進め！
c36d88c0ab674e146d880f036271b4b6b093e4ff.english:
Kid! Pecciotta!
The rest of the way is up to you!

f0fc3176c4a3b49e89241d932627cf26a9e777f0.source:
そして残りふたつの
仕掛けを解いてこい！
f0fc3176c4a3b49e89241d932627cf26a9e777f0.english:
Now, go and solve the
remaining two mechanisms!

e3824b833c0c3b09f8b8a381e9013ed5d788944a.source:
まったく……！
やるとは思っていたが
決断が早すぎるぜ……！
e3824b833c0c3b09f8b8a381e9013ed5d788944a.english:
Good grief…!
I figured you’d do it, but
that was a quick decision…!

8f8f21cbb44e98b2f77f262cda2116030696fdda.english: Hmph…Did that knock you off your feet?

d8e6065ad8cede5c7ac874599346245809d201d8.source:
馬鹿言ってんじゃねェよ。
あまりにいい女がいたもんで
惚れ直していたところさ。
d8e6065ad8cede5c7ac874599346245809d201d8.english:
Don’t talk nonsense.
I just happened to see such a fine woman
that I found myself falling for her all over again.

edb61f3b396603c69818233539bdc6c0a5aeb75a.source:
フハハハ！
さっさと行って、戻ってこい。
edb61f3b396603c69818233539bdc6c0a5aeb75a.english:
Hahahaha!
Go on then, and make sure you come back.

c5027913d6fde308cae8acdbc5a360cedddfffa4.source:
行くぜ、ニィちゃん！
ぼさっとしてたら置いてくぞ！
c5027913d6fde308cae8acdbc5a360cedddfffa4.english:
Let’s go,kid!
Don’t just stand there, or I’m leaving you behind!

9adf2791459b3b4d211b97cd968b54ca8fd2be67.source:
あのスイッチで、別の場所が
開いたに違いねェ。
9adf2791459b3b4d211b97cd968b54ca8fd2be67.english:
That switch must have
opened up a path somewhere else.

92cd3fc7112e7a511bfe5d64dfec4e1fddd4f9c7.source:
ニィちゃん。
休んでる時間が惜しい。
すぐに探索へ戻るぜ。
92cd3fc7112e7a511bfe5d64dfec4e1fddd4f9c7.english:
Hey, kid.
We can’t afford to waste time resting.
Let’s get back to exploring.

d13cdbd3436e5f1aa0796688f8c9e4bbe1e94803.source:
迷いもセずニ行って、
戻っテきたギャ……。
d13cdbd3436e5f1aa0796688f8c9e4bbe1e94803.english:
He went there without a moment's hesitation,
and now he’s back...

2af5bd2b905af24e33e2f921212ff32858d83b20.source: とんでモない『ゆうき』だギャ……！

a703be4817a74ff82f7465a0174f79a8aa5edf07.source:
ポテンシャは
『勇気の力』を覚えた！

1658d0b243ccfffe4eccae7be984155c83341c1e.source:
か、鍵だギャ！
伝説の通り『不壊の水晶』ノ中に
鍵ガ入ってイるギャ！
1658d0b243ccfffe4eccae7be984155c83341c1e.english:
A, a key!
Just like in the legend, there’s a key
inside the 'Indestructible Crystal'!

0d179a2ee3236b50c7e4036bb631a31cff7c7a02.source:
アレが、守護モンスターの
部屋へと続く扉の鍵……か。
0d179a2ee3236b50c7e4036bb631a31cff7c7a02.english:
So that’s the key to the door
leading to the guardian monster’s chamber...huh?

50ea5653651d635b8180c10c5963a756b32c3b49.english: Hey, kid...are you really going to do this?

71cceae7e03027d12720c2cb4ba95902b7a1acaa.source:
確かに、俺の武器じゃ、
時間がいくらあっても足りやしねェ。
71cceae7e03027d12720c2cb4ba95902b7a1acaa.english:
I mean, with my weapon...
it would take forever, not enough time in the world.

5b37b38d3e3e8ba3630890f1abcf8b327435cb56.source: やってみなくちゃわからねェさ。
5b37b38d3e3e8ba3630890f1abcf8b327435cb56.english: Won't know until I try, will I?

51608eb3b703a61784e6dd3da468a676e2e0a531.source:
マダムがいない今、
ここでの最大戦力はニィちゃんだ。
任せるだけさ。
51608eb3b703a61784e6dd3da468a676e2e0a531.english:
With Madam gone,
you’re the strongest one we’ve got here.
I’m leaving it to you.

562c0b06c4406387c269bf8e8837364cfdcd8d12.source:
何度も斬りつけたが
水晶には傷ひとつない……。
562c0b06c4406387c269bf8e8837364cfdcd8d12.english:
I’ve slashed at it over and over,
but there isn’t a single scratch on the crystal...

eee63d8a906a51c4e688d94ed741af4b8a29fb22.source:
……やっぱリ無理だったんだギャ。
早くあきらめテ、マダムにも
やメさせたほうガいいギャ。
eee63d8a906a51c4e688d94ed741af4b8a29fb22.english:
...So it really was impossible, huh?
We should just give up, and tell Madam to
stop, too.

507dca3928e376c3b4cbb76ff0b4b73ee008881a.source:
お前の“無理”を
押しつけるなって
マダムに言われなかったか？
507dca3928e376c3b4cbb76ff0b4b73ee008881a.english:
Didn't Madam tell you
not to force your own idea of ​​“impossible”
onto others?

79313cd146312837fc373affefa105a093cca51e.source:
まだ終わっちゃいねェよ。
なあ、ニィちゃん？

7b47dfffde3ca79656d6b461bf55051cadb0ad32.source: ま、まだ続けル気なのかギャ！？

ebbec6bb10eb6cd3d1ceb8367bb7c0ca97eb0653.source:
続けるさ。
ニィちゃんが
『あきらめない限り』な。
ebbec6bb10eb6cd3d1ceb8367bb7c0ca97eb0653.english:
I’ll keep going.
As long as you
don’t give up.

a4b5edd0f0ea3d76669fe9268f7fafd98c76f64e.source:
数百回にも及ぶ剣戟を浴びせたが
不壊の水晶には傷ひとつない。
a4b5edd0f0ea3d76669fe9268f7fafd98c76f64e.english:
I’ve struck it hundreds of times with my blade,
but there isn’t a single scratch on the Indestructible Crystal.

7ce0755e900d79cadc183ab158df2575d6737bdd.source:
何百、何千と斬りつけたが
不壊の水晶には傷ひとつない。
7ce0755e900d79cadc183ab158df2575d6737bdd.english:
I’ve slashed at it hundreds, thousands of times,
yet the Indestructible Crystal remains completely unmarked.

d6fb2240167ad93c92bc317a9b4a0c4dbdd3866a.source:
持ちうる全ての剣技をぶつけたが
不壊の水晶には傷ひとつない。
d6fb2240167ad93c92bc317a9b4a0c4dbdd3866a.english:
I’ve thrown every sword technique I possess at it,
but the Indestructible Crystal doesn’t have a single scratch.

5180aa3c7c6b560d9f0ad3ca18c2738494692f18.source: 不壊の水晶にヒビが入った！
5180aa3c7c6b560d9f0ad3ca18c2738494692f18.english: A crack has appeared in the Indestructible Crystal!

12f847380f428dec33041042602d4297df21aec0.source:
す、スごいギャ……。
コイツ、もしかしテ本当ニ……。

268b1cef0a685503cf0dc326fc400eebed574e01.source:
……よくやったな、ニィちゃん。
この通り、鍵は手に入ったぜ。
268b1cef0a685503cf0dc326fc400eebed574e01.english:
…Well done, kid.
Look at that, we’ve got the key.

75e12cb2f7c376e4039768b47f45296eaa8647e2.source:
ああ。こうしちゃいられねェな。
マダムのところに戻ろうぜ。
75e12cb2f7c376e4039768b47f45296eaa8647e2.english:
Right.No time to waste now.
Let’s head back to Madam’s place.

c8ab21b4f06ed08f731cd50791801108dda5cd14.source:
……このモヤモヤしタ
気持ちハなんだギャ？
こんなノ、初めてだギャ……。
c8ab21b4f06ed08f731cd50791801108dda5cd14.english:
...What is this
strange feeling I'm having?
I've never feltanything like this before...

d2121acb33f9ae4c6a86380cf903636c6ff82663.source:
あいつハ最後の最後まデ
『あきらめなかった』ギャ……。
d2121acb33f9ae4c6a86380cf903636c6ff82663.english:
Right up until the very end,
he never gave up...

028fd43067e08b6d5e6630dcac10dc6b9c8d06cc.source: とんでもない『ちから』だギャ……！

36ad8d4796d4b4bcbd6ba1fcda954601cc6690b7.source:
ポテンシャは
『諦めない力』を覚えた！
36ad8d4796d4b4bcbd6ba1fcda954601cc6690b7.english:
Potentia has
learned the 'power of not giving up'!

f07ef39c62d89dd46d6efb320f14a8babf2f69b0.source:
やり遂げてきたぜ。
マダムの信頼に応えてな。
f07ef39c62d89dd46d6efb320f14a8babf2f69b0.english:
I got it done.
I lived up to Madam's trust, after all.

17babb4dba8318b5720101663fb1a0f3de9a4201.source:
ふむ……少し足もとがふらつくな。
恐怖の口も伊達じゃないか。
17babb4dba8318b5720101663fb1a0f3de9a4201.english:
Hmm...my legs feel a bit unsteady.
So, the 'Maw of Terror' is no joke, then.

8e95e9889e1426a1a27e46f87c6ac6212b489eb9.english: Fully restored!　How’s that for a comeback?!

a09c83e4e0ef363ed5d343abca0c26cdb11dac1a.source:
恐怖の口ニ、こんナにも長イ間
腕ヲ入れ続けた者ハいないギャ！
a09c83e4e0ef363ed5d343abca0c26cdb11dac1a.english:
No one has ever kept their arm inside
that terrifying maw for this long before!

6a4550baf3b3566d089701bf449dd113a29f1769.source:
モンスターでサえそうなのニ
マダムは一体何者なンだギャ！？
6a4550baf3b3566d089701bf449dd113a29f1769.english:
Even monsters wouldn’t dare…
Just who, or what, is Madam, anyway?!

ed560f7b18360b711017035dbd3630486dfcea26.source:
何者と言われても私は私だ。
それ以外ではないぞ。
ed560f7b18360b711017035dbd3630486dfcea26.english:
Who am I, you ask? I am simply myself.
Nothing more, nothing less.

0b15535129ac1ba21ae22ee51b2c0cc9dbacb577.source:
それニ！　自分ノ命が
削られていル間……
一度モ腕を抜かなったギャ！
0b15535129ac1ba21ae22ee51b2c0cc9dbacb577.english:
And on top of that…　even as her own life force
was being drained away…
she never once pulled her arm out!

73a99ef625fe24ef3a39415928396572160949ae.source:
こイつらガ戻ってこナけれバ、
どウなっていたカわからないギャ！
どうしてソんなことガできるギャ！？
73a99ef625fe24ef3a39415928396572160949ae.english:
If they hadn’t come back…
who knows what might have happened?!
How on earth could she do something like that?!

769d80d6155afec5aa1dc45eb4fde9eebbfa4cec.source:
そりゃあ、ボウヤとペツォッタが
必ず役割を果たして戻ってくると
信……知っていたからな。
769d80d6155afec5aa1dc45eb4fde9eebbfa4cec.english:
Well, I knew, I knew for a fact that you and Pecciotta
would fulfill your
roles and come back.

52b17da07d365020ad5aa49ab669fd9d292e971c.source:
なにひとつとして
心配事なんてないだろう。
現にこうして戻ってきたわけだし。
52b17da07d365020ad5aa49ab669fd9d292e971c.english:
There was never anything
to worry about in the first place.
After all, here you are, back again.

3f5561d3c29daa4f7ea17d3e9ffdadbaae6a6afa.source:
『しんじていた』……のかギャ？
他人を？　自分を？

edaf77347138105a24e4882eaa4dd145859beebb.source:
両方だ。
それと、信じてたんじゃなくて
知ってたんだ！　訂正しろ。
edaf77347138105a24e4882eaa4dd145859beebb.english:
Both.
And for the record, I didn't 'believe'
it; I *knew* it!　Get it right.

fdbd0ae5b443803738b4a00ff691cc4eeacda44c.source:
まったく……もうこの話はやめだ！
鍵が手に入ったんだろ！
行くぞ、ボウヤ！　ペツォッタ！
fdbd0ae5b443803738b4a00ff691cc4eeacda44c.english:
Honestly...Enough about this already!
We’ve got the key, haven't we?
Let’s go! Come on, kid!　Pecciotta!

62fa3a97a89748a4c086f389bbac5b46d2c03a0f.source:
誰かト自分ヲ『しんじる』……。
すごい『ちから』だギャ……！
62fa3a97a89748a4c086f389bbac5b46d2c03a0f.english:
To 'believe' in others... and in oneself...
What an incredible 'power'...!

530fcfd9ed3ff7209b36f60fd0de3340aa3316ad.source:
ポテンシャは
『信じる力』を覚えた！

cc644dd82e05d1a168f2edd6e7601d292483ff97.source:
アア……この先ノ光景ヲ
また見られルなんて……。
懐かシい……懐かシいギャ……。
cc644dd82e05d1a168f2edd6e7601d292483ff97.english:
Ah...To think I’d get to see
this sight again...
So nostalgic...So nostalgic, gya...

bf449f4982fd2fa101b1493746b712628c55a7dc.source:
ポテンシャ。
進む前に聞きたいことがある。
bf449f4982fd2fa101b1493746b712628c55a7dc.english:
Potentia.
Before we move on, I have a question for you.
